description.en: Prophetic supplications for every occasion from Hisn al-Muslim and the Sunnah — all grades included
description.ar: أدعية نبوية لكل المناسبات من حصن المسلم والسنة — جميع الدرجات

source.en: Hisn al-Muslim (selected chapters), Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abi Dawud, Sunan at-Tirmidhi, Sunan an-Nasa'i, Sunan Ibn Majah, Musnad Ahmad; enrichment cross-checked against sunnah.com, islamqa.info and published Hisn al-Muslim chapters (2026-08)
source.ar: حصن المسلم (أبواب مختارة)، صحيح البخاري، صحيح مسلم، سنن أبي داود، سنن الترمذي، سنن النسائي، سنن ابن ماجه، مسند أحمد

description.en: Additional morning supplications
description.ar: أدعية صباح إضافية

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.

translation.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
translation.ar: اللهم بك أصبحنا وبك أمسينا وبك نحيا وبك نموت وإليك النشور

virtues.en: Morning remembrance.
virtues.ar: من أذكار الصباح.

title.en: Allahumma Anta Rabbi La Ilaha Illa Ant (Detailed)
title.ar: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت (مفصل)

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ، وَمَا لَمْ يَشَأْ لَمْ يَكُنْ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant, 'alayka tawakkaltu, wa anta Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim. Ma sha'a-llahu kana, wa ma lam yasha' lam yakun. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'Aliyyil-'Azim. A'lamu anna-llaha 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, wa anna-llaha qad ahata bi-kulli shay'in 'ilma.

translation.en: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You. Upon You I rely, and You are the Lord of the Magnificent Throne. What Allah wills happens, and what He does not will does not happen. There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. I know that Allah is competent over all things and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.
translation.ar: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت...

virtues.en: Allah suffices him against the matters of this world and the Hereafter.
virtues.ar: من قالها كفاه الله ما أهمه.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Malik al-Ash'ari.

items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh.

translation.en: I testify that there is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
translation.ar: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن محمداً عبده ورسوله

virtues.en: Allah makes him a quarter of his salvation from the Fire.
virtues.ar: كفّأ الله عنه ربع الإيمان.

title.en: Morning Dua — Allah's Protection by Night and Day

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsaina wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur.

translation.en: O Allah, by Your grace we enter the morning, and by Your grace we enter the evening. By You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

virtues.en: A comprehensive morning and evening dua acknowledging complete dependence on Allah for every transition of time. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3391, graded Sahih).

title.en: Evening Dua — Safety in the Night

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsaina wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykal-maseer.

translation.en: O Allah, by Your grace we enter the evening, and by Your grace we enter the morning. By You we live, by You we die, and to You is the return.

virtues.en: The evening counterpart of the morning dua. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3391). The Prophet emphasized the importance of morning and evening adhkar as a spiritual fortress for every believer.

title.en: Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas Morning Protection

items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq min sharri ma khalaq.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of that which He created.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Recite Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas in the morning and evening three times, and they will suffice you against everything. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3575, graded Hasan). These two surahs are the ultimate shields against all harm.

title.en: Dua for Guidance in the Morning

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعِلْمَ النَّافِعَ وَالرِّزْقَ الطَّيِّبَ وَالْعَمَلَ الْمَتَقَبَّلَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-‘ilman-nafi'a war-rizqat-tayyiba wal-‘amalal-mutaqabbal.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, goodly provision, and accepted deeds.

virtues.en: One of the most comprehensive morning duas taught by the Prophet. (Sunan Ibn Majah 925, graded Sahih). In three brief phrases, it encompasses the three pillars of a blessed day: knowledge, provision, and accepted worship.

title.en: Saying Subhanallah 100 Times in the Morning

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi.

translation.en: Glory is to Allah and all praise is due to Him.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever says Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi one hundred times in the morning, no one will bring on the Day of Judgment anything better than what he brought, except one who said the same as him or more. (Sahih Muslim 2692).

title.en: Dua for Family Protection in the Morning

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma'asmashi shay-un fil-ardi wa la fis-samai wa huwas-sami'ul-aleem.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever recites this three times in the morning, nothing will harm him. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5088, graded Sahih). It is the most concise yet powerful morning protection dua.

description.en: Duas for eating and drinking
description.ar: أدعية الطعام والشراب

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.

translation.en: In the name of Allah.
translation.ar: بسم الله

virtues.en: Prevents Shaytan from sharing the food.
virtues.ar: يمنع الشيطان من المشاركة في الطعام.

items.notes: Narrated by Aisha.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah.

translation.en: In the name of Allah at the beginning and at the end.
translation.ar: بسم الله أوله وآخره

virtues.en: If one forgets to say Bismillah at the start.
virtues.ar: إذا نسي أن يذكر اسم الله في أوله.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.

translation.en: Praise be to Allah Who has fed me this and provided me with it without any strength or power on my part.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي أطعمني هذا ورزقنيه من غير حول مني ولا قوة

virtues.en: Previous sins are forgiven.
virtues.ar: غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه.

items.notes: Narrated by Mu'adh bin Anas.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa at'imna khayran minh.

translation.en: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.
translation.ar: اللهم بارك لنا فيه وأطعمنا خيراً منه

virtues.en: Barakah in provision.
virtues.ar: البركة في الرزق.

items.notes: Narrated by Ibn Abbas.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.

translation.en: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy on them.
translation.ar: اللهم بارك لهم فيما رزقتهم واغفر لهم وارحمهم

virtues.en: Dua for hosts.
virtues.ar: دعاء لأهل البيت.

items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Dhahaba-z-zama', wabtallatil-'uruq, wa thabatal-ajru in sha'a-llah.

translation.en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
translation.ar: ذهب الظمأ وابتلت العروق وثبت الأجر إن شاء الله

virtues.en: Recited when breaking the fast.
virtues.ar: تقال عند الإفطار.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik li-ahlil-bayti fima razaqtahum.

translation.en: O Allah, bless the people of the house in what You have provided them.
translation.ar: اللهم بارك لأهل البيت فيما رزقتهم

virtues.en: Dua of the Prophet ﷺ for the hosts.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يدعو لأهل البيت.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimeen.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Allah is pleased with His servant when he eats and praises Him for it. (Sahih Muslim 2734).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirih.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and at its end.

virtues.en: If one forgets to say Bismillah at the beginning of the meal, this is what they should say when they remember. (Sunan Abi Dawud 3767).

items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Dhahaba az-zama wa abtallatil-uruq wa thabatal-ajru insha Allah.

translation.en: Thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

virtues.en: The Prophet's dua when breaking his fast. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2357).

title.en: Bismillah wa Ala Barakatillah Before Eating

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى بَرَكَةِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wa ala barakatillah.

translation.en: In the name of Allah and upon the blessings of Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet said to a boy: Say Bismillah and eat with your right hand, and eat from what is nearest to you. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5376). This fuller version adds seeking barakah in the food.

title.ar: الحمد لله الذي أطعمنا وسقانا وجعلنا من المسلمين

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana minal-muslimeen.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us from among the Muslims.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Allah is pleased with His servant when he eats a morsel and praises Him for it, or drinks a sip and praises Him for it. (Sahih Muslim 2734).

items.arabic: صَائِمٌ فَأَفْطِرُوا عِنْدَكُم
items.transliteration: Sa'imun fa-aftiru ‘indakum.

translation.en: A fasting person, so break your fast with us (or: provide food for the fasting person).

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever gives food to a fasting person to break his fast, he will have a reward like that of the fasting person, without any reduction in the fasting person's reward. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 807).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minhu.

translation.en: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

virtues.en: When milk was brought to the Prophet, he would say this dua before drinking it. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 1887). Milk is mentioned in the Quran as a pure drink (16:66).

title.en: Dua for a New Food Not Eaten Before

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَارْزُقْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi warzuqna khayran minhu.

translation.en: O Allah, bless it for us and provide us with something better than it.

virtues.en: When the Prophet was given a new food he had not eaten before, he would say this. (Sunan Abi Dawud 3783). It teaches gratitude and humility when experiencing new blessings.

title.en: Dua When Eating at Someone Else's Home

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum waghfir lahum warhamhum.

translation.en: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them, and have mercy on them.

virtues.en: It is recommended to make dua for your host when eating as their guest. (Sahih Muslim 2042). The angels say Amin to your dua for your host.

description.en: Duas for wearing clothes
description.ar: أدعية لبس الثياب

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadhath-thawba wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.

translation.en: Praise be to Allah Who clothed me in this garment and provided it for me without any strength or power on my part.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي كساني هذا الثوب ورزقنيه من غير حول مني ولا قوة

virtues.en: Previous sins forgiven.
virtues.ar: غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه.

items.notes: Narrated by Mu'adh bin Anas.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanih, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah.

translation.en: O Allah, to You is praise — You clothed me in it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
translation.ar: اللهم لك الحمد أنت كسوتنيه...

virtues.en: Recited when wearing new clothes.
virtues.ar: تقال عند لبس ثوب جديد.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.

translation.en: In the name of Allah.
translation.ar: بسم الله

virtues.en: Saying Bismillah before undressing conceals from the jinn.
virtues.ar: التسمية قبل الخلع تستر من الجن.

items.notes: Weak hadith but practice is recommended.

description.en: Duas for the bathroom and wudu
description.ar: أدعية الخلا والوضوء

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الخبث والخبائث

virtues.en: Enter with left foot first.
virtues.ar: يدخل بالرجل اليسرى.

items.notes: Narrated by Anas bin Malik.

items.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
items.transliteration: Ghufranak.

translation.en: Your forgiveness.
translation.ar: غفرانك

virtues.en: Exit with right foot first.
virtues.ar: يخرج بالرجل اليمنى.

items.notes: Narrated by Aisha.

items.arabic:
أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh. Allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabin waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin.

translation.en: I testify that there is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves.
translation.ar: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له...

virtues.en: The eight gates of Paradise are opened for him — he enters from whichever he wishes.
virtues.ar: فتحت له أبواب الجنة الثمانية يدخل من أيها شاء.

items.notes: Narrated by Umar bin al-Khattab.

description.en: Duas for entering/leaving home and mosque
description.ar: أدعية دخول وخروج المنزل والمسجد

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna.

translation.en: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.
translation.ar: بسم الله ولجنا وبسم الله خرجنا وعلى ربنا توكلنا

virtues.en: Say salam to your family when entering, then this dhikr.
virtues.ar: سلم على أهلك ثم قل هذا الذكر.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Malik al-Ash'ari.

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ، أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ، أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ، أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ، أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'ala-llah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. / Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla, aw udalla, aw azilla, aw uzalla, aw azlima, aw uzlama, aw ajhala, aw yujhala 'alayya.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, I rely upon Allah, and there is no power and no strength except by Allah. / O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I stray or be led astray, slip or be made to slip, oppress or be oppressed, behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.
translation.ar: بسم الله توكلت على الله...

virtues.en: An angel responds: 'You are guided, defended, and protected,' and devils flee.
virtues.ar: يقال له: هديت وكفيت ووقيت.

items.notes: Narrated by Anas bin Malik.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ftah li abwaba rahmatik.

translation.en: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.
translation.ar: اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك

virtues.en: Enter with the right foot first.
virtues.ar: يدخل بالرجل اليمنى.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Humaid.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك من فضلك

virtues.en: Exit with the left foot first.
virtues.ar: يخرج بالرجل اليسرى.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fahassin khuluqi.

translation.en: O Allah, just as You have made my form beautiful, beautify my character.
translation.ar: اللهم كما حسنت خلقي فحسن خلقي

virtues.en: Recited when looking in the mirror.
virtues.ar: تقال عند النظر في المرآة.

items.notes: Narrated by Abdullah bin Mas'ud.

description.en: Duas for traveling
description.ar: أدعية السفر

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha...

translation.en: Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us...
translation.ar: سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا...

virtues.en: Recited when mounting for travel.
virtues.ar: تقال عند ركوب الدابة.

items.notes: Narrated by Abdullah bin Sarjis.

items.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
items.transliteration: Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li-Rabbina hamidun.

translation.en: Returning, repenting, worshipping, to our Lord praising.
translation.ar: آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون

virtues.en: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ when returning.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقولها عند العودة.

items.notes: Narrated by Ibn Umar.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fiha.

translation.en: O Allah, bless us in it.
translation.ar: اللهم بارك لنا فيها

virtues.en: Recited when entering a town while traveling.
virtues.ar: تقال عند دخول بلدة.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wal-hamdulillahi. Subhanalladhee sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrineen. Wa inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, and all praise is for Allah. Glorified is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have otherwise subdued it. And indeed we, to our Lord, will surely return.
translation.ar: بسم الله والحمد لله. سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين. وإننا إلى ربنا لمنقلبون.

reference.notes: Also reported: Quran 43:13-14; [Quran].

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught this dua to be recited when boarding any conveyance. It acknowledges that without Allah making the vehicle subservient to us, we could not control it. (Sahih Muslim 1342). This same phrase is found in the Quran (43:13-14) describing what the believers say when mounting their riding animals.
virtues.ar: علم النبي ﷺ هذا الدعاء عند ركوب أي مركبة. يعترف بأنه لولا تسخير الله المركبة لما استطعنا السيطرة عليها (مسلم ١٣٤٢). وقد ذُكر هذا اللفظ في القرآن (٤٣:١٣-١٤) وصفاً لما يقوله المؤمنون عند ركوب الدواب.

title.en: Dua When Mounting and Raising Oneself

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ، ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ. ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، ٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ ٱللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ.
items.transliteration: Bismillah. Alhamdulillah. Subhanalladhee sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrineen. Wa inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon. Alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah, alhamdulillah. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Subhanakallahumma inni zhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa anta.

translation.en: In the name of Allah. All praise is for Allah. Glorified is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have otherwise subdued it. And indeed we, to our Lord, will return. All praise is for Allah (three times). Allah is the Greatest (three times). Glory be to You, O Allah, I have wronged myself so forgive me, for indeed no one forgives sins except You.
translation.ar: بسم الله. الحمد لله. سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين. وإننا إلى ربنا لمنقلبون. الحمد لله، الحمد لله، الحمد لله. الله أكبر، الله أكبر، الله أكبر. سبحانك اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي فإنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت.

virtues.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that whenever the Prophet (peace be upon him) wished to mount a riding animal, he would say the opening words, and when he sat firmly on its back, he would say "Alhamdulillah" three times and "Allahu Akbar" three times, then supplicate: "Glory be to You, O Allah, I have wronged myself so forgive me, for indeed no one forgives sins except You." (Sunan Abi Dawud 2602, graded Sahih by Al-Albani).
virtues.ar: عن علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه أن النبي ﷺ كان إذا أراد أن يركب دابته قال المقدمة، فإذا استوى عليها قال: "الحمد لله" ثلاثاً و"الله أكبر" ثلاثاً، ثم قال: "سبحانك اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي فإنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت" (أبو داود ٢٦٠٢، صححه الألباني).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ.
items.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas-aluka fee safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-amali ma tardha. Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha watwii anna bu-dahu. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safri wal-khaleefatu fil-ahli. Allahumma inni a-udhu bika min wat-has-is-safari wa ka-abatil-manzari wa soo-il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahli.

translation.en: O Allah, we ask You on this journey for righteousness, piety, and deeds that are pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a gloomy sight, and from a bad outcome regarding wealth and family.
translation.ar: اللهم إنا نسألك في سفرنا هذا البر والتقوى، ومن العمل ما ترضى. اللهم هون علينا سفرنا هذا واطو عنا بعده. اللهم أنت الصاحب في السفر والخليفة في الأهل. اللهم إني أعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر وكآبة المنظر وسوء المنقلب في المال والأهل.

virtues.en: This is one of the most comprehensive travel duas taught by the Prophet (peace be upon him). It covers every aspect of travel: asking for good conduct, ease of journey, protection while away, and safety for those left behind. (Sahih Muslim 1342, narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar). The phrase "You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family" highlights that Allah is the ultimate protector both for the traveler and for their family at home.
virtues.ar: من أشمل أدعية السفر التي علمها النبي ﷺ. يغطي كل جوانب السفر: طلب حسن السيرة وتسهيل الرحلة والحماية أثناء الغياب والأمان لمن تركهم وراءه (مسلم ١٣٤٢، عن ابن عمر). قوله "أنت الصاحب في السفر والخليفة في الأهل" يبرز أن الله هو الحافظ الأعظم للمسافر وأهله.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى سَلَّمَنَا وَٱلَّذِى أَوَانَا وَٱلَّذِى جَعَلَنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ. آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahilladhee sallamana walladhee awana walladhee ja-alana minal-muslimeen. A-iboona ta-iboona abidoona li-rabbina hamidoon.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has granted us safety, who has brought us back, and who has made us among the Muslims. We return, repentant, worshipping our Lord and praising Him.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي سلمانا والذي آوانا والذي جعلنا من المسلمين. آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون.

reference.notes: Also Muslim 2769, Ibn Majah 2994

virtues.en: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) returned from a journey, he would begin with the masjid and pray two rak-ahs, then say: "We return repentant, worshipping our Lord and praising Him." (Sahih al-Bukhari 3085, Sahih Muslim 2769). The additional phrase "Alhamdulillahilladhee sallamana walladhee awana" is reported by Ibn Majah. Starting with the masjid upon return shows the priority of gratitude to Allah.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا قدم من سفر بدأ بالمسجد فركع فيه ركعتين ثم يقول: "آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون" (البخاري ٣٠٨٥، مسلم ٢٧٦٩). وزيادة "الحمد لله الذي سلمنا والذي آوانا" رواها ابن ماجه. البدء بالمسجد يظهر أولية شكر الله.

items.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ. لَا يَغْرُرَنَّكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ صَدَقُوا۟ بِمَآ صَدَقُوا۟ بِهِ وَقَدْ كُذِّبُوا۟ بِهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَيْمَٰنَةَ سِوارًا عَلَى ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ.
items.transliteration: A-iboona ta-iboona abidoona li-rabbina hamidoon. La yaghrurannakum annahum qad sadaqoo bima sadaqoo bihi wa qad kudhdhiboo bihi min qablu wa qad ja-alnal-aymanata siwaran alal-mushrikeen.

translation.en: We return repentant, worshipping our Lord and praising Him. Let it not delude you that they believed, for they [previously] disbelieved before, and We have placed upon the hearts of the disbelievers a covering so they do not understand. (This last part is Quranic - Quran 58:14, meant as a general reminder of gratitude for guidance.)
translation.ar: آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون.

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would say upon returning from travel: "We return repentant, worshipping our Lord and praising Him." (Sahih al-Bukhari 3085). Ibn Umar added: "The Messenger of Allah and his companions would say this upon every return from travel." This expresses humility and gratitude, acknowledging that safe return is a blessing from Allah deserving of thanks and renewed worship.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقول عند العودة من السفر: "آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون" (البخاري ٣٠٨٥). وروى ابن عمر أن النبي ﷺ وأصحابه كانوا يقولونه عند كل عودة. هذا يعبر عن التواضع والشكر والاعتراف بأن العودة الآمنة نعمة من الله تستحق الشكر والعبادة.

title.en: Dua for the Traveler and Those Left Behind

items.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ ٱللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ.
items.transliteration: Astawdi-ullaha deenaka wa amanataka wa khawatima amalik.

translation.en: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust (family and property), and the final outcome of your deeds.
translation.ar: أستودع الله دينك وأمانتك وخواتيم عملك.

reference.notes: Also Abu Dawud 2598, Tirmidhi 3444

virtues.en: When someone sets out on a journey, the Prophet (peace be upon him) taught that those seeing them off should say: "I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds." (Sunan Abi Dawud 2597, graded Sahih by Al-Albani). In response, the traveler says: "I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds." (Sunan Abi Dawud 2598). This mutual dua creates a bond of trust between the traveler and those remaining behind.
virtues.ar: عندما يسافر أحد، علم النبي ﷺ أن من يودعه يقول: "أستودع الله دينك وأمانتك وخواتيم عملك" (أبو داود ٢٥٩٧، صححه الألباني). ويجيبه المسافر بنفس الدعاء (أبو داود ٢٥٩٨). هذا الدعاء المتبادل يخلق رابطة ثقة بين المسافر والمقيمين.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ ٱلْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ ٱلشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَآ أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ ٱلرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا.
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sab-i wa ma adhlalna, wa rabbal-ardinas-sab-i wa ma aqlalna, wa rabbash-shayateeni wa ma adhlalna, wa rabbar-riyahi wa ma dharnay. As-aluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahliha wa khayra ma feeha, wa a-udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ahliha wa sharri ma feeha.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they have shaded, Lord of the seven earths and what they carry, Lord of the devils and what they have misled, Lord of the winds and what they scatter. I ask You for the good of this town, the good of its people, and the good of what is in it. And I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people, and the evil of what is in it.
translation.ar: اللهم رب السماوات السبع وما أظللن، ورب الأراضين السبع وما أقللن، ورب الشياطين وما أضللن، ورب الرياح وما ذرين. أسألك خير هذه القرية وخير أهلها وخير ما فيها، وأعوذ بك من شرها وشر أهلها وشر ما فيها.

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) would recite this comprehensive dua upon entering a town or city. It is one of the most thorough supplications, invoking Allah as Lord of the heavens, earths, devils, and winds, then asking for the good of the place and seeking refuge from its evil. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2574, graded Sahih by Al-Albani). This dua teaches us to seek Allah protection in every new environment.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقرأ هذا الدعاء الشامل عند دخول أي بلدة. وهو من أشمل الأدعية، ي.invocating الله كرب السماوات والأرضين والشياطين والرياح ثم يسأل خير المكان ويستعيذ من شره (أبو داود ٢٥٧٤، صححه الألباني). هذا الدعاء يعلمنا طلب حماية الله في كل بيئة جديدة.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ لَنَا فِى سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا بَرَكَةً، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِى سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ.
items.transliteration: Allahum-maj-al lana fee safarina hadha barakah. Allahumma inna nas-aluka fee safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-amali ma tardha.

translation.en: O Allah, place blessings in this journey of ours. O Allah, we ask You in this journey of ours for righteousness, piety, and deeds that are pleasing to You.
translation.ar: اللهم اجعل لنا في سفرنا هذا بركة. اللهم إنا نسألك في سفرنا هذا البر والتقوى، ومن العمل ما ترضى.

virtues.en: This dua is taken from the well-known comprehensive travel dua of the Prophet (peace be upon him) (Sahih Muslim 1342). Asking for barakah (blessings) in travel means asking Allah to make the journey productive, safe, and spiritually beneficial - not merely reaching the destination but gaining goodness throughout the journey itself.
virtues.ar: مأخوذ من دعاء السفر الشامل للنبي ﷺ (مسلم ١٣٤٢). طلب البركة في السفر يعني سؤال الله أن يجعل الرحلة مثمرة وآمنة ومفيدة روحياً - ليس مجرد الوصول للوجهة بل كسب الخير طوال الرحلة.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar.

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest.
translation.ar: الله أكبر.

reference.notes: When ascending: Allahu Akbar. When descending: Subhan Allah.

virtues.en: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: "When we went up a high place, we would say Allahu Akbar, and when we descended, we would say Subhan Allah." (Sahih al-Bukhari 2993). The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "When a servant says Subhan Allah, a date-palm tree is planted for him in Paradise." (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3464, graded Hasan). These simple words transform every rise and fall during travel into ongoing worship.
virtues.ar: عن جابر بن عبد الله رضي الله عنه قال: "كنا إذا علونا كبرنا وإذا هبطنا سبحنا" (البخاري ٢٩٩٣). وقال النبي ﷺ: "من قال سبحان الله غُرست له نخلة في الجنة" (الترمذي ٣٤٦٤، حسن). هذه الكلمات البسيطة تحول كل صعود وهبوط في السفر إلى عبادة مستمرة.

items.notes: Say Allahu Akbar when ascending, and Subhan Allah when descending.

items.arabic: سَمِعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلَائِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذًا بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ.
items.transliteration: Sami-a sami-un bi-hamdillahi wa husni bala-ihi alayna. Rabbana sahibna wa af-dil alayna. A-idhan billahi minan-nar.

translation.en: May a hearer hear our praise of Allah and His good favor upon us. O our Lord, be our companion and bestow favors upon us. I seek refuge in Allah from the Fire.
translation.ar: سمع سامع بحمد الله وحسن بلائه علينا. ربنا صاحبنا وأفضل علينا. عائذاً بالله من النار.

virtues.en: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) was on a journey and the dawn broke, he would say this dua. (Sahih Muslim 2717, narrated by Abu Hurairah). It is a beautiful dawn supplication that acknowledges Allah favors, asks for His companionship throughout the day, and seeks His protection from the Hellfire. The early morning in travel is a special time for supplication as the Prophet encouraged making dua in the last third of the night.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ إذا كان في سفر وأسحر قال هذا الدعاء (مسلم ٢٧١٧، عن أبي هريرة). هو دعاء سح رائع يعترف بفضل الله ويسأل صحبته طوال اليوم ويستعيذ من النار. السحر في السفر وقت خاص للدعاء كما حث النبي على الدعاء في الثلث الأخير من الليل.

title.en: Dua When Feeling Fear During Travel

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَدَّنَآ إِلَىٰ بَيْتِنَا سَالِمِينَ غَانِمِينَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا رَحْمَٰنُ. لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ.
items.transliteration: Allahumma ruddana ila baytina salimeena ghanimeena bi-rahmatika ya Rahman. La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen.

translation.en: O Allah, return us to our home safely, with gains, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful. There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: اللهم ردنا إلى بيتنا سالمين غانمين برحمتك يا رحمن. لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين.

reference.notes: Quran reference: 21:87 (Dua of Yunus)

virtues.en: The second part of this dua is the supplication of Prophet Yunus (Jonah), peace be upon him, which the Prophet (peace be upon him) called "the dua of distress" and said: "No Muslim ever supplicates with it for anything except that Allah responds to him." (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3505, graded Sahih). Combining it with the prayer for safe return makes it a powerful supplication during moments of fear or difficulty while traveling.
virtues.ar: الجزء الثاني من هذا الدعاء هو دعاء يونس عليه السلام الذي سماه النبي ﷺ "دعاء ذي النون" وقال: "لا يدعو به مسلم في شيء قط إلا استجاب الله له" (الترمذي ٣٥٠٥، صحيح). جمعه مع دعاء العودة الآمنة يجعله دعاء قوياً في لحظات الخوف أو الصعوبة أثناء السفر.

title.en: Dua When Stopping to Rest at Night

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَوَلِ ٱللَّيْلِ وَمَا يَجْرِى فِى ٱلظَّلَٰمِ، وَمِنْ شُرُورِ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَمِنْ شُرُورِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَمِنْ شُرُورِ كُلِّ غَائِلَةٍ إِلَّا غَائِلَةً تَغُولُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَٰنُ.
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a-udhu bika min hawalil-layli wa ma yajree fizh-zhalam. Wa min shuroorid-dawabbi wa min shurooris-sa-ati wa min shuroori kulli gha-ilatin illa gha-ilatan taghulu bi-khayr ya Rahman.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the terrors of the night and what it brings under darkness, and from the evils of beasts, and from the evils of the Last Hour, and from the evils of every lurking predator, except a predator that seizes with good, O Most Merciful.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من هول الليل وما يجري في الظلام. ومن شرور الدواب ومن شرور الساعة ومن شرور كل غائلة إلا غائلة تغول بخير يا رحمن.

virtues.en: When stopping to rest during a night journey, the Prophet (peace be upon him) would seek refuge in Allah from the fears of the dark night, wild animals, the trials of the Last Hour, and all hidden dangers. (Musnad Ahmad 8079, graded Hasan by Al-Albani). This dua is especially important for travelers who must rest in unfamiliar places at night, providing spiritual protection against all conceivable harms.
virtues.ar: عند النزول للراحة أثناء رحلة ليلية، كان النبي ﷺ يستعيذ بالله من مخاوف الليل المظلم والحيوانات البرية وفتن الساعة وكل الأخطار الخفية (أحمد ٨٠٧٩، حسنه الألباني). هذا الدعاء مهم خاصة للمسافرين الذين يبيتون في أماكن غير مألوفة ليلاً.

title.en: Dua of Farewell to the Traveler

items.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ ٱللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ. زَوَّدَكَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ ٱلْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنتَ.
items.transliteration: Astawdi-ullaha deenaka wa amanataka wa khawatima amalik. Zawwadakallahut-taqwa, wa ghafara dhambaka wa yassara lakal-khayra haythu ma kunta.

translation.en: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds. May Allah provide you with taqwa (piety), forgive your sins, and make goodness easy for you wherever you are.
translation.ar: أستودع الله دينك وأمانتك وخواتيم عملك. زودك الله التقوى، وغفر ذنبك ويسر لك الخير حيثما كنت.

reference.notes: Also Tirmidhi 3444

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "If anyone entrusts his brother with something, let him say: I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds." And the traveler should respond: "I entrust to Allah your religion, your trust, and the final outcome of your deeds." (Sunan Abi Dawud 2597). The additional part "May Allah provide you with taqwa" is recorded in the hadith literature as a beautiful farewell blessing. This is the sunnah way to bid farewell to a traveler.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: "إذا استودع أحدكم أخاه فليقل: أستودع الله دينك وأمانتك وخواتيم عملك" ويجيبه المسافر (أبو داود ٢٥٩٧). زيادة "زودك الله التقوى" مسجلة في الأحاديث كبركة ودعاء جميل عند الوداع. هذه هي السنة في توديع المسافر.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ، ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، ٱللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ.
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay-in qadeer. Subhanallahi, alhamdulillahi, Allahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد وهو على كل شيء قدير. سبحان الله، الحمد لله، الله أكبر، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله.

reference.notes: Also Ibn Majah 2892

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said about the pilgrim and the one performing Umrah: "They are delegates (or guests) of Allah. If they call upon Him, He responds to them; and if they ask Him for forgiveness, He forgives them." (Ibn Majah 2892, graded Sahih). He also said: "The journey is a kind of torture, so whoever undertakes a journey should give charity, and whoever cannot should fast two days before traveling." Continuous dhikr during travel was the Prophetic practice - the journey itself becomes an act of worship. (Sahih al-Bukhari 1528, 2991).
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ عن الحاج والمعتمر: "هم وفد الله، إن دعوه أجابهم، وإن استغفروه غفر لهم" (ابن ماجه ٢٨٩٢، صحيح). وقال: "السفر قطعة من العذاب". كان من هدي النبي ﷺ الإكثار من الذكر في السفر فتصبح الرحلة نفسها عبادة (البخاري ١٥٢٨، ٢٩٩١).

title.en: Dua for Protection from Travel Harm

items.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ، مَشَيْنَا بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ وَصَلَّيْنَا عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَسْأَلُكَ فِى سَفَرِى هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اَللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اَللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِى السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِى ٱلْأَهْلِ.
items.transliteration: Bismillah. Mashayna bismillahi wa sallayna ala nabiyyina Muhammadin. Allahumma inni as-aluka fee safaree hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-amali ma tardha. Allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha watwii anna bu-dahu. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safri wal-khaleefatu fil-ahli.

translation.en: In the name of Allah. We travel in the name of Allah and send blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad. O Allah, I ask You in this journey for righteousness, piety, and deeds that are pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Successor over the family.
translation.ar: بسم الله. مشينا بسم الله وصلينا على نبينا محمد ﷺ. اللهم إني أسألك في سفري هذا البر والتقوى، ومن العمل ما ترضى. اللهم هون علينا سفرنا هذا واطو عنا بعده. اللهم أنت الصاحب في السفر والخليفة في الأهل.

reference.notes: Combined with Tirmidhi 3445

virtues.en: This combines the opening bismillah, salawat upon the Prophet, and the most comprehensive travel dua taught by the Prophet (peace be upon him). (Sahih Muslim 1342). Beginning travel in the name of Allah and with salawat upon the Prophet brings blessings and protection. The addition of salawat is reported in the Hadith of Anas (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3445, graded Hasan). This is the ideal dua to begin any journey with.
virtues.ar: يجمع بين البسملة والصلاة على النبي وأشمل دعاء سفر علمه النبي ﷺ (مسلم ١٣٤٢). بدء السفر باسم الله والصلاة على النبي يجلب البركة والحماية. إضافة الصلاة مروية عن أنس (الترمذي ٣٤٤٥، حسن). هذا هو الدعاء المثالي لبدء أي رحلة.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَمِنَ الْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْنِ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَمِنْ سُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safari wa ka'abatil-munqalab, wa minal-hawri ba'dal-kawn, wa min da'watil-madhloom, wa min su'il-manzari fil-ahli wal-mal.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a sorrowful return, from misfortune after well-being, from the supplication of the oppressed, and from an evil look upon my family and wealth.

virtues.en: The Prophet used to say this whenever he set out on a journey. (Sahih Muslim 1342).

items.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
items.transliteration: A'ibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li-Rabbina hamidun.

translation.en: Returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

virtues.en: The Prophet would say this when returning from travel. (Sahih al-Bukhari 2893). It frames the return as an opportunity for repentance and renewed worship.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inna na'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safari wa ka'abatil-munqalab.

translation.en: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel and the grief of return.

virtues.en: A shorter version of the travel dua, emphasizing reliance on Allah throughout the journey. The companions would recite this collectively when traveling. (Sahih Muslim 1342).

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilni mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijni mukhraja sidqin waj'al li min ladunka sultanan nasira.

translation.en: My Lord, cause me to enter a truthful entrance and cause me to exit a truthful exit, and grant me from Your presence a supporting authority.

virtues.en: The dua of Musa when he left Madyan and traveled to Egypt (Quran 17:80). It is ideal for entering any new city, workplace, or situation, asking Allah for honesty and divine support.

description.en: Duas for times of hardship, anxiety, anger, and grief
description.ar: أدعية وقت الكرب والقلق والغضب والحزن

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

virtues.en: Never refused.
virtues.ar: ما دعا بها مسلم إلا استجاب الله له.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduk, ibnu 'abdik, ibnu amatik...

translation.en: O Allah, I am Your servant... make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness, and the reliever of my anxiety.
translation.ar: اللهم إني عبدك...

virtues.en: Allah replaces distress with joy.
virtues.ar: أذهب الله حزنه وهمه وأبدله مكانه فرحاً.

items.notes: Narrated by Abdullah bin Mas'ud.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, incapacity and laziness, stinginess and cowardice, the burden of debt, and the domination of men.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الهم والحزن...

virtues.en: Comprehensive dua for relief from anxiety, laziness, and debt.
virtues.ar: تعوذ من ثمان.

items.notes: Narrated by Anas bin Malik.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu la ilaha illa ant.

translation.en: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is no deity except You.
translation.ar: اللهم رحمتك أرجو...

virtues.en: Comprehensive supplication.
virtues.ar: من جوامع الدعاء.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Bakr.

title.en: Dua of Distress (La Ilaha Illa Allah)

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahul-'Azimul-Halim, la ilaha illa-llahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim, la ilaha illa-llahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ard wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karim.

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله العظيم الحليم...

virtues.en: The dua of distress.
virtues.ar: دعوات الكرب.

items.notes: Narrated by Ibn Abbas.

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan.
translation.ar: أعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'If a man gets angry and says this, his anger will go away.'
virtues.ar: إن الشيطان يجرى من ابن آدم مجرى الدم.

items.notes: Narrated by Sulayman bin Sard.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahlan, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla.

translation.en: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy. You make difficulty easy if You will.
translation.ar: اللهم لا سهل إلا ما جعلته سهلاً وأنت تجعل الحزن إذا شئت سهلاً

virtues.en: Recited when facing difficulty.
virtues.ar: تقال عند صعوبة الأمر.

items.notes: Narrated by Anas.

items.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakeel.

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

virtues.en: Ibrahim said this when thrown into the fire. When the believers heard it, they said: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best Disposer of affairs. (Quran 3:173). The Prophet said: Whoever says this seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him in all matters.

title.en: The Dua of Distress — The Most Comprehensive

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِي حُكْمِكَ عَدْلٌ فِي قَضَائِكَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي وَنُورَ صَدْرِي وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni abduka ibnu abdika ibnu amatika nasiyati biyadika madin fi hukmika adlun fi qada'ika. As'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsaka aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqika aw anzaltahu fi kitabika aw ista'tharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaybi indaka an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabia qalbi wa nura sadri wa jala'a huzni wa dhahaba hammi.

translation.en: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your female servant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, by which You have named Yourself, or taught to any of Your creation, or revealed in Your Book, or kept in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the dispeller of my sorrow, and the remover of my worry.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: No person ever supplicates with this for a matter except that Allah responds to it. (Musnad Ahmad 13063, graded Sahih). It is the most comprehensive dua for sorrow, grief, anxiety, and distress.

title.en: Seeking Refuge from Grief and Sorrow

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'udhu bika minal-‘ajzi wal-kasal, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from the burden of debt and the domination of men.

virtues.en: The Prophet taught this comprehensive dua covering internal and external anxieties. (Sunan Abi Dawud 1554). It addresses worry, sadness, laziness, fear, stinginess, and financial or social pressure.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-‘afwa wal-‘afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-‘afwa wal-‘afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: No servant asks Allah for these two things but that he is guaranteed them. (Sunan Ibn Majah 3871, graded Sahih). This is one of the most encompassing duas for total well-being.

title.en: Hasbiyallahu — The Full Version for Anxiety
title.ar: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو

items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-arshil-azeem.

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Noble Throne.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever is afflicted with anxiety, sorrow, pain, or hardship, and says this seven times, Allah will remove his affliction. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5019, graded Sahih). It combines tawakkul, tawhid, and trust in Allah's power.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-ma'thami wal-maghram.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من المأثم والمغرم.

virtues.en: When asked "what is al-maghram?" the Prophet ﷺ said: "a man who owes a debt and cannot repay it." He made this a constant refuge in his prayer.

title.en: Sufficiency from Debt — Halal Over Haram

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-kfini bi-halalika 'an haramika, wa aghnini bi-fadlika 'amman siwak.

translation.en: O Allah, suffice me with the lawful instead of the unlawful, and enrich me by Your bounty so I am free of need of anyone else.
translation.ar: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك وأغنني بفضلك عمن سواك.

virtues.en: The debt-burdened man was taught this by the Prophet ﷺ; the muezzin announced it after prayers so all could learn it.

description.en: Duas for seeking forgiveness
description.ar: أدعية الاستغفار والتوبة

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrahu.

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me all my sins — the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the hidden.
translation.ar: اللهم اغفر لي ذنبي كله دقه وجله وأوله وآخره وعلانيته وسره

virtues.en: The most comprehensive dua for forgiveness.
virtues.ar: أجمع دعاء للاستغفار.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Hurairah.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta...

translation.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You...
translation.ar: سيد الاستغفار

virtues.en: Whoever says it with certainty in the morning/evening and dies, enters Paradise.
virtues.ar: من قالها موقناً بها دخل الجنة.

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.

translation.en: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
translation.ar: أستغفر الله وأتوب إليه

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said this 70-100 times a day.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يستغفر في اليوم أكثر من سبعين مرة.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Hurairah.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indik, warhamni innaka antal-Ghafurur-Rahim.

translation.en: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins except You. So forgive me a forgiveness from You, and have mercy on me. Indeed, You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
translation.ar: اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي ظلماً كثيراً...

virtues.en: The best dua for seeking forgiveness.
virtues.ar: من أفضل الاستغفار.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Bakr.

title.en: The Supplication of Prophet Yunus — For Distress and Forgiveness

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa ant subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen.

translation.en: None has the right to be worshipped except You. Glory is to You. Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: No Muslim ever supplicates to Allah with this supplication for any matter except that Allah answers it. (Tirmidhi 3505, graded Hasan Sahih). This is the dua of Prophet Yunus inside the belly of the whale.

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir li wa liwalidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu'minan wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minat.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my home as a believer, and the believing men and believing women.

virtues.en: A comprehensive istighfar that includes parents and all believers. From the Quran (Quran 71:28), the dua of Prophet Nuh. It teaches us to not only seek forgiveness for ourselves but for all believers.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana zhalamna anfusana wa il lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

virtues.en: The first dua of repentance in human history, taught by Allah to Adam (Quran 7:23). After eating from the forbidden tree, Allah accepted this repentance. It is one of the most powerful duas for seeking forgiveness.

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-azeemalladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum wa atubu ilayh.

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Magnificent, besides Whom there is none worthy of worship, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

virtues.en: An expanded form of istighfar that includes Allah's greatest attributes. The Prophet said: The most superior way of asking for forgiveness is to say: O Allah, You are my Lord... (Bukhari 6306). This combines the attributes with repentance.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana dhunubana wa israfana fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna alal-qawmil-kafireen.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess in our affair and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.

virtues.en: From Quran 3:147, a dua of the believers that combines forgiveness with asking for steadfastness and victory. It teaches that seeking forgiveness should be paired with asking for strength to avoid repeating sins.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir li ma qaddamtu wa ma akhkhartu wa ma asrartu wa ma a'lantu wa ma asraftu wa ma Anta a'lamu bihi minni. Antal-muqaddimu wa Antal-mu'akhkhiru, la ilaha illa Ant.

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me for what I have done in the past and what I will do in the future, what I have concealed and what I have revealed, and whatever excess I have committed. You are the One who advances and the One who delays. There is no deity except You.

virtues.en: The most comprehensive personal istighfar. The Prophet said: Whoever says this in the evening and dies, he enters Paradise. And whoever says it in the morning and dies, he enters Paradise. (Sahih Muslim 2719).

items.arabic: رَبِّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir anna sayyi-atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and expiate our evil deeds and cause us to die with the righteous.

virtues.en: From Quran 3:193. This dua asks for three things: forgiveness of sins, expiation of evil deeds (covering them completely), and a death among the righteous. It is one of the most beautiful Quranic duas for repentance.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَنُورًا فِي بَصَرِي وَنُورًا فِي سَمْعِي وَنُورًا فِي شَعْرِي وَنُورًا فِي بَشَرِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma-j'al fi qalbi nuran wa nuran fi basari wa nuran fi sam'i wa nuran fi sha'ri wa nuran fi bashari.

translation.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing, light in my hair, and light in my skin.

virtues.en: The Prophet's dua for light (Sahih Muslim 763). Asking for light is a form of seeking forgiveness because sins create darkness in the heart. This dua purifies the heart from the darkness of sin. (Sahih Muslim 763).

title.en: Sayyid al-Istighfar — The Master Forgiveness Dua at Night

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant khalaqtani wa ana abduka wa ana ala ahdika wa wadika mastata'tu a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu abu'u laka bini'matika alayya wa abu'u bithanbi faghfir li fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.

translation.en: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I adhere to Your covenant and Your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge before You Your blessing upon me, and I acknowledge my sins. So forgive me, for indeed none forgives sins except You.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever says this with conviction in the evening and dies before dawn, he will be among the people of Paradise. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3555, graded Hasan). It is called Sayyid al-Istighfar — the master of all supplications for forgiveness.

title.en: Rabbi-ghfir Li Between the Two Sajdas

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir li, Rabbi-ghfir li.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me. My Lord, forgive me.

virtues.en: The Prophet would say this between the two prostrations in every rak'ah of prayer. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 284, graded Sahih). It is a sunnah that most Muslims neglect, yet it is one of the most guaranteed times for the acceptance of dua.

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ رَبِّي مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ آثَمْتُهُ أَوْ غَرَرْتُ بِنَفْسِي أَوْ عَلَيْهِ أَوْ خَطَأْتُ أَوْ عَمَدْتُ أَوْ سَرَرْتُ أَوْ أَعْلَنْتُ أَنَا الْمُذْنِبُ الْمُقِرُّ وَلَا مُعْفِيَ وَلَا مُقَلِّبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha Rabbi min kulli dhambin athamtu aw gharartu bi-nafsi aw alayhi aw akhta'tu aw amadtu aw sarrartu aw a'lantu ana al-mudh-nibu al-muqirru wa la mu'fiya wa la muqalliba illa ant.

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, my Lord, from every sin I committed, or deceived myself about, or was careless with, whether in secret or openly. I am the confessing sinner, and there is no forgiver and no changer of hearts except You.

virtues.en: The Prophet's comprehensive daily istighfar (Sahih Ibn Hibban, graded Sahih). It covers every possible category of sin — intentional, unintentional, secret, and public — and ends with the crucial acknowledgment that only Allah can change hearts.

description.en: Duas for knowledge and sustenance
description.ar: أدعية العلم والرزق

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي، وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي، وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي، يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
items.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wah-lul 'uqdatam min lisani, yafqahu qawli.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech.
translation.ar: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري...

virtues.en: Excellent dua for students and speakers.
virtues.ar: دعاء موسى عليه السلام.

items.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma.

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
translation.ar: رب زدني علماً

virtues.en: The only dua the Prophet ﷺ was commanded to make in the Quran.
virtues.ar: الدعاء الوحيد الذي أمر الله به نبيه في القرآن.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumman-fa'ni bima 'allamtani, wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni, wa zidni ilma.

translation.en: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
translation.ar: اللهم انفعني بما علمتني وعلمني ما ينفعني وزدني علماً

virtues.en: Dua for beneficial knowledge.
virtues.ar: دعاء العلم النافع.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-kfini bi-halalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bi-fadlika 'amman siwak.

translation.en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful against what You have made unlawful, and enrich me by Your bounty beyond need of anyone other than You.
translation.ar: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك وأغنني بفضلك عمن سواك

virtues.en: Proven dua for halal provision.
virtues.ar: دعاء للرزق الحلال.

items.notes: Narrated by Ali bin Abi Talib.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and accepted deeds.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك علماً نافعاً ورزقاً طيباً وعملاً متقبلاً

virtues.en: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ after Fajr.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقولها بعد الفجر.

items.notes: Narrated by Umm Salamah.

title.en: Good in This World and the Next

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah wafil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: The most comprehensive dua for all-round well-being. (Sahih Muslim 2721).

title.en: O Allah, Provide for Us Halal

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-kfini bihalalika an haramika wa aghnini bifadlika amman siwaka.

translation.en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful so that I do not need what You have made unlawful, and enrich me through Your bounty so that I have no need of anyone besides You.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever says this seven times after Fajr and seven times after Maghrib, Allah will suffice him for what concerns him. (Sahih - graded by Al-Albani in Sahih al-Jami 205).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَىٰ بَرَكَةِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wa ala barakatillah.

translation.en: In the name of Allah and upon the blessings of Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: When one of you eats, let him mention the name of Allah. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5376). This phrase brings barakah (blessing) to whatever you begin, including financial transactions.

title.en: O Allah, I Seek Refuge from Poverty
title.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الفقر

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُوعِ فَإِنَّهُ بِئْسَ الضَّجِيعُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ فَإِنَّهَا بِئْسَتِ الْبِيتَةُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ju'i fa-innahu bi'sad-daji'u wa a'udhu bika minal-khiyanati fa-innaha bi'satil-bit'atu.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from hunger, for it is an evil bedfellow, and I seek refuge in You from betrayal, for it is an evil inner companion.

virtues.en: The Prophet used to seek refuge from hunger and betrayal (Sunan Abi Dawud 1545). Hunger leads to weakness in faith, and betrayal destroys trust. This dua protects from both.

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarkan wa Anta khayrul-munzileen.

translation.en: My Lord, settle me in a blessed landing place, and You are the best of settlers.

virtues.en: The dua of Ibrahim when he left his family in Makkah (Quran 14:37). A beautiful dua for moving, relocating, or starting something new, asking for barakah in the new place.

title.en: Benefit Me With What You Have Taught Me

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Allahummanfa'ni bima allamtani wa allimni ma yanfa'uni wa zidni ilman.

translation.en: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

virtues.en: The Prophet used to say this supplication. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3597, graded Hasan). It covers three essential aspects: gratitude for existing knowledge, the desire for more, and the crucial request that all knowledge be beneficial.

title.en: O Allah, Teach Us the Quran

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْنَا الْقُرْآنَ وَارْزُقْنَا تِلَاوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا حُجَّةً يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma allimnal-Qur'ana warzuqna tilawatahu ana'al-layli wa atrafan-nahari waj'alhu lana hujjatan ya Rabbal-alameen.

translation.en: O Allah, teach us the Quran and grant us its recitation during the hours of night and at the edges of the day, and make it a proof for us, O Lord of the worlds.

virtues.en: A beautiful dua for Quranic knowledge and consistent recitation. The scholars have emphasized that seeking knowledge of the Quran should be the foundation of all Islamic learning. (Sunan Ibn Majah).

title.en: O Allah, Open My Chest for Understanding

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahul uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast, ease for me my task, and untie the knot in my tongue that they may understand my speech.

virtues.en: The dua of Musa before going to Pharaoh (Quran 20:25-28). It is ideal before exams, presentations, or any situation requiring clarity of thought and effective communication. It asks for confidence, ease, and eloquence.

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا وَارْزُقْنِي فَهْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilman warzuqni fahman.

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge and grant me understanding.

virtues.en: A dua combining the Quranic prayer for increased knowledge with a request for deep understanding. The Prophet said: When Allah wishes good for a person, He grants him understanding of the religion. (Sahih al-Bukhari 71). Understanding (fiqh) is superior to mere memorization.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي
items.transliteration: Allahummanfa'ni bima allamtani wa allimni ma yanfa'uni.

translation.en: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me and teach me what will benefit me.

virtues.en: The first part preserves existing knowledge from being wasted, and the second part seeks new knowledge. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3597). The scholars say the most effective way to retain knowledge is to act upon it and teach it to others.

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever seeks Allah's forgiveness persistently, Allah will appoint for him a way out of every distress, and a relief from every anxiety, and will provide for him from where he did not reckon. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6307). Saying this 100 times after Fajr is a prophetic practice for abundance.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي أَهْلِي وَمَالِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik li fi ahli wa mali.

translation.en: O Allah, place blessing in my family and my wealth.

virtues.en: A beautiful and comprehensive dua for barakah. The Prophet said: If Allah blesses a person with provision but does not place barakah in it, he will not benefit from it. (Sahih al-Jami 3340). Barakah transforms limited resources into abundant sufficiency.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهُ وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayrahu wa khayra ma fihi wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma fihi.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness and the goodness of what is in it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what is in it.

virtues.en: When purchasing anything — a home, a car, clothing, or even food — this dua ensures Allah's blessing in the purchase and protection from hidden defects or harm. (Sunan Abi Dawud 3618).

title.ar: دعاء الرزق من حيث لا يحتسب

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummak-fini bihalalika an haramika.

translation.en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful so that I have no need of what You have made unlawful.

virtues.en: A concise but powerful dua asking Allah for halal sufficiency. The Prophet said: Allah will provide for one who is mindful of Him from sources he could never imagine. (Sahih al-Bukhari). This dua embodies that principle.

title.en: O Allah, Open My Chest for Understanding

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri wa yassir li amri.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task.

virtues.en: The dua of Musa (Quran 20:25-26). Excellent for before exams or difficult studies.

title.en: Increase in Knowledge — Rabbi Zidni Ilma

items.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Wa qul: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.

translation.en: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge. (Qur'an 20:114 — the only thing the Prophet ﷺ was commanded to ask for increase.)
translation.ar: وقل رب زدني علمًا.

virtues.en: The concise study dua: before lessons, revision, exams — asking for increase, not just acquisition.

description.en: Duas for the sick and recovery
description.ar: أدعية المرضى والشفاء

items.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha'a-llah.

translation.en: No harm, it is a purification, if Allah wills.
translation.ar: لا بأس طهور إن شاء الله

virtues.en: Recited when visiting the sick.
virtues.ar: تقال للمريض.

items.notes: Narrated by Ibn Abbas.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn...

translation.en: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye...
translation.ar: اللهم رحمتك أرجو...

virtues.en: Comprehensive dua for the sick.
virtues.ar: من أذكار المرض.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Bakr.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal him. You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing — a healing that leaves no disease.
translation.ar: اللهم رب الناس أذهب البأس اشف أنت الشافي...

virtues.en: Recite 7 times on the sick person.
virtues.ar: يقولها سبع مرات.

items.notes: Narrated by Aisha.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa-llah, al-malikul-haqqul-mubin.

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah, the True, the Evident King.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله الملك الحق المبين

virtues.en: Prompt the dying to say La ilaha illa Allah.
virtues.ar: لقّنوا موتاكم: لا إله إلا الله.

items.notes: Narrated by Mu'adh bin Jabal.

items.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
items.transliteration: Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatun lil-mu'mineen.

translation.en: And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and a mercy to the believers.

virtues.en: Allah declares the Quran to be a source of healing (Quran 17:82). The Prophet said: There is no disease that Allah has created, except that He also has created its treatment. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5678).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi arqika min kulli shay-in yu'dhika, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'aynin hasid. Allah yashfika, bismillahi arqika.

translation.en: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that may harm you, from the evil of any soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.
