virtues.en: This is the ruqyah that Jibril performed upon the Prophet (Sahih Muslim 2192). The Prophet then used this same ruqyah for his family. It is the most authentic and complete ruqyah formula.

title.en: Seven Times: I Seek Refuge in Allah's Perfect Words
title.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامة سبع مرات

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hamma wa min kulli 'aynin lammah.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever says this seven times in the morning and seven times in the evening, nothing will harm him. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6107).

title.en: Lord of Mankind, Remove the Harm

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nasi adhhibil-ba's, ishfi Antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm. Heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness.

virtues.en: The Prophet taught Aisha this dua for the sick (Sahih al-Bukhari 5743, Sahih Muslim 2191). It acknowledges that Allah alone is the true Healer.

title.en: Place Your Hand on the Pain

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً) وَأَعُوذُ بِعِزَّةِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
items.transliteration: Bismillah (3x) wa a'udhu bi'izzatillahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir.

translation.en: In the name of Allah (3 times). I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I feel and fear.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Place your hand on the part of the body that hurts and say Bismillah three times, then say this dua seven times. (Sahih Muslim 2202). This is a direct prophetic treatment for pain.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.

translation.en: In the name of Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Place your hand on the area of pain and say Bismillah three times, then say: I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I find and fear, seven times. (Sahih Muslim 2192). This is a direct prophetic medical prescription.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الْكَبِيرِ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ عِرْقٍ وَنَارٍ وَحَرٍّ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-kabeer a'udhu billahil-azeem min sharri kulli irqin wa narin wa har.

translation.en: In the name of Allah, the Great. I seek refuge in Allah, the Mighty, from the evil of every vein, fire, and heat.

virtues.en: When the Prophet had a fever, he would recite this dua. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5744). The scholars explain that fever is like the heat of Hell, and this dua seeks Allah's protection from it.

title.en: Dua for Eye Pain and Sickness

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اشْفِهِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ishfihi.

translation.en: O Allah, heal him (or her).

virtues.en: The Prophet would visit the sick and make a brief but powerful dua for their healing. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 971). Though simple, when said with sincerity and conviction, it carries immense power because healing is entirely in Allah's hands.

description.en: Duas for rain, wind, thunder, and natural phenomena
description.ar: أدعية المطر والرياح والرعد

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an.

translation.en: O Allah, [make it] a beneficial rain.
translation.ar: اللهم صيباً نافعاً

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said this when rain fell.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقوله عند المطر.

items.notes: Narrated by Aisha.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ، وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bi-hamdih, wal-mala'ikatu min khifatih.

translation.en: Glory to Him by Whom the thunder declares His praise, and the angels [as well] from fear of Him.
translation.ar: سبحان الذي يسبح الرعد بحمده والملائكة من خيفته

virtues.en: Recited when hearing thunder.
virtues.ar: تقال عند سماع الرعد.

items.notes: Narrated by Abdullah bin az-Zubayr.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for its good, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك خيرها وأعوذ بك من شرها

virtues.en: Recited when the wind blows strongly.
virtues.ar: تقال عند هبوب الريح.

items.notes: Narrated by Aisha.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman, was-salamati wal-Islam, wat-tawfiqi lima tuhibbu wa tarda, Rabbuna wa RabbukAllah.

translation.en: O Allah, bring it upon us with security, faith, safety, and Islam, and success in what You love and are pleased with. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
translation.ar: اللهم أهله علينا بالأمن والإيمان...

virtues.en: Recited upon seeing the new moon.
virtues.ar: تقال عند رؤية الهلال.

items.notes: Narrated by Talhah bin Ubaidullah.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الْآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma hawalayna wa la 'alayna, Allahumma 'ala al-akami wa az-zirab, wa butuni al-awdiyati, wa manabiti ash-shajar.

translation.en: O Allah, around us and not upon us; O Allah, on the hills and mountains, the valleys and the places where trees grow.
translation.ar: اللهم حوالينا ولا علينا، اللهم على الآكام والظراب وبطون الأودية ومنابت الشجر.

virtues.en: Said when rain threatens harm or flooding — asking that its harm be diverted to uninhabited land.

items.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
items.transliteration: Mutirna bi-fadlillahi wa rahmatih.

translation.en: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.
translation.ar: مُطرنا بفضل الله ورحمته.

virtues.en: Attributing rain to Allah's bounty alone — not to stars or omens — is part of tawhid; the Prophet ﷺ said this after leading the people in rain-soaked dawn prayer.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعًا، نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلًا غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma aghithna, Allahumma aghithna, Allahumma asqina ghaythan mughithan mari'an mari'an, nafi'an ghayra darirrin, 'ajilan ghayra ajil.

translation.en: O Allah, relieve us; O Allah, relieve us; O Allah, send us rain — a relieving, wholesome, nourishing rain, beneficial and not harmful, swift and not delayed.
translation.ar: اللهم أغثنا، اللهم أغثنا، اللهم اسقنا غيثًا مغيثًا مريئًا مريعًا نافعًا غير ضار عاجلًا غير آجل.

virtues.en: The cry of the community in drought — raised in the istisqa prayer or simply in earnest supplication.

description.en: Duas for marriage, intimacy, and children
description.ar: أدعية الزواج والمعاشرة والأطفال

items.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
items.transliteration: Baraka-llahu laka, wa baraka 'alayk, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr.

translation.en: May Allah bless you, and may His blessings descend upon you, and may He unite you both in goodness.
translation.ar: بارك الله لك وبارك عليك وجمع بينكما في خير

virtues.en: The Prophet's ﷺ dua for newlyweds.
virtues.ar: دعاء النبي ﷺ للمتزوج.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Hurairah.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.

translation.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Shaytan away from us, and keep Shaytan away from what You have provided us.
translation.ar: بسم الله اللهم جنبنا الشيطان...

virtues.en: If a child is decreed, Shaytan will never harm him.
virtues.ar: لم يضره شيطان أبداً.

items.notes: Narrated by Ibn Abbas.

items.arabic: أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'idhuha bika wa dhurriyyataha minash-shaytanir-rajim.

translation.en: I seek refuge for her (and her offspring) in You from the accursed Shaytan.
translation.ar: أعيذها بك وذريتها من الشيطان الرجيم

virtues.en: Recited over a newborn.
virtues.ar: تعوذ المولود.

items.notes: Narrated by Sa'id bin al-Musayyab.

items.arabic: (يُؤَذَّنُ فِي أُذُنِهِ الْيُمْنَى)
items.transliteration: (Adhan is given in the right ear of the newborn.)

translation.en: Adhan is called in the newborn's right ear. This was the practice of the Prophet ﷺ.
translation.ar: يؤذن في أذن المولود اليمنى

virtues.en: Sunnah practice for newborns.
virtues.ar: من سنن المولود.

items.notes: Narrated by Abu Rafi'.

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah innaka sami'ud-du'a'.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a goodly offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

virtues.en: The dua of Zakariya, which Allah answered by granting him Yahya. (Quran 3:38).

title.en: Dua for Righteous Spouse and Family

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lilmuttaqeena imama.

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort of our eyes and make us a leader of the righteous.

virtues.en: One of the most beautiful family duas in the Quran (Quran 25:74). It asks for spouses and children who bring comfort to the eyes and for the family to be leaders in righteousness.

items.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi-rahmahuma kama rabbayani sagheera.

translation.en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

virtues.en: From the Quran (Quran 17:24), the continuation of the command to be dutiful to parents. This dua should be recited daily for living or deceased parents.

title.en: Dua for Mercy on Deceased Parents

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir li wa liwalidayya warhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera.

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me and my parents and have mercy on them as they brought me up when I was small.

virtues.en: A combined dua for forgiveness and mercy for deceased parents. The Prophet emphasized making dua for parents after their death, as they can no longer do good deeds for themselves. (Sahih Muslim 1631).

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir li wa liwalidayya walilmumineena yawma yaqumul-hisab.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.

virtues.en: The dua of Ibrahim and his righteous descendants (Quran 14:41). It teaches us to include our parents in our duas, especially for forgiveness on the Day of Judgment.

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi-j'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati rabbana wataqabbal dua.

translation.en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer and from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

virtues.en: Ibrahim's dua (Quran 14:40) is one of the most beautiful prayers for family. It links personal worship with the hope that one's children will also be steadfast in prayer. The dua was accepted across generations.

items.arabic: أَعِيذُهُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
items.transliteration: A'idhuhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hamma wa min kulli aylin lammah.

translation.en: I seek refuge for him in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

virtues.en: The Prophet would seek protection for Hassan and Husayn with these words (Sahih al-Bukhari 3371). It is sunnah to recite this over newborns and children for their protection from all harm.

description.en: Duas for Friday and special occasions
description.ar: أدعية الجمعة والأوقات الفاضلة

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad.

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
translation.ar: اللهم صل وسلم على نبينا محمد

virtues.en: Increase salawat on Friday.
virtues.ar: أكثروا من الصلاة عليّ يوم الجمعة.

items.notes: Narrated by Aws bin Aws.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

translation.en: There is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له...

virtues.en: Among the moments when supplication is answered on Friday.
virtues.ar: فيه ساعة لا يوافقها عبد مسلم يسأل الله فيها خيراً إلا أعطاه.

items.notes: Narrated by Jabir.

items.arabic: سُورَةُ الْكَهْفِ
items.transliteration: Surah Al-Kahf

translation.en: Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave)

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever reads Surah Al-Kahf on Friday, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays. (Sahih al-Bayhaqi 3/249, graded Sahih by Al-Albani). In another narration: Whoever reads Surah Al-Kahf on Friday, it will be a light for him from one Friday to the next. (Sahih al-Jami 6470).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ، اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammad wa ala ali Muhammad kama sallayta ala Ibrahim wa ala ali Ibrahim innaka hamidun majid. Allahumma barik ala Muhammad wa ala ali Muhammad kama barakta ala Ibrahim wa ala ali Ibrahim innaka hamidun majid

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

virtues.en: This is the Durood Ibrahim recited in every prayer during the final tashahhud. The Prophet said: Say: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad... for whoever sends one blessing upon me, Allah will send ten blessings upon him. (Sahih Muslim 406). It is the most complete form of salawat.

title.en: Dua Between Adhan and Iqamah on Friday
title.ar: الدعاء بين الأذان والإقامة يوم الجمعة

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammati was-salatil-qa'imati, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilata wab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtah

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the Wasilah and the highest rank, and raise him to the praised station that You have promised him.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: The supplication made between the Adhan and the Iqamah is not rejected. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 212, graded Sahih). This is especially emphasized on Friday.

items.arabic: سُورَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ وَسُورَةُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ
items.transliteration: Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Surah Al-Munafiqun

translation.en: Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Surah Al-Munafiqun

virtues.en: Ibn Umar reported that the Prophet used to recite Surah Al-Jumu'ah and Surah Al-Munafiqun in the Friday prayer. (Sahih Muslim 879). Another narration says: The Prophet used to recite Surah Al-Jumu'ah in the first rak'ah and Surah Al-Munafiqun in the second. (Sahih Muslim 878).

items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh

translation.en: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever performs ghusl on Friday, then goes early to the mosque, walks (not rides), sits near the imam, listens attentively, and does not engage in idle talk, will have a reward for every step the reward of fasting and praying at night for one year. (Abu Dawud 345). Adding istighfar 70 times expiates sins from one Friday to the next. (Tirmidhi 3606).

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir li dhunubi

translation.en: O Allah, forgive my sins

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever performs ghusl on Friday like the ghusl for janabah, then goes to the mosque as early as possible, that is like offering a camel in sacrifice. Whoever goes in the second hour, it is like a cow. In the third, like a horned ram. In the fourth, like a hen. In the fifth, like an egg. When the imam comes out, the angels present themselves to listen to the reminder. (Sahih al-Bukhari 881, Sahih Muslim 850).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as-aluka khayra hadhihil-laylati wa khayra ma fiha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma fiha

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night and the good in it, and I seek Your protection from its evil and the evil in it.

virtues.en: The night before Friday (Thursday night) has special virtues. The Prophet said: There is a specific hour on Friday during which a Muslim would be granted whatever he supplicates for, as long as he does not supplicate for something sinful or for severing family ties. (Sahih al-Bukhari 935).

title.en: Dua for the Specific Hour on Friday
title.ar: الدعاء في الساعة المستجابة يوم الجمعة

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: There is an hour on Friday, and if a Muslim catches it while offering prayer and asks something from Allah, Allah will definitely meet his demand. (Sahih al-Bukhari 935). Scholars differ on which hour, but many say it is the last hour after Asr. This comprehensive dua is one of the most frequently used.

title.ar: صلاة ابن مسعود على النبي ﷺ

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَاتَكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَإِمَامِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-j'al salataka wa rahmataka wa barakatika ala sayyidil-mursaleena wa imamil-muttaqeena wa rasuli rabbil-'alameen Muhammadin "abduka wa rasulika

translation.en: O Allah, place Your prayer, Your mercy, and Your blessings upon the master of the messengers, the leader of the righteous, and the messenger of the Lord of the worlds, Muhammad, Your servant and messenger.

virtues.en: Abdullah ibn Masud used to teach this comprehensive salawat on Friday. It includes honoring the Prophet with the highest titles: master of messengers, leader of the righteous. (Musnad Ahmad 4250, graded Hasan).

title.en: Dua Upon Hearing the Adhan on Friday
title.ar: الدعاء عند سماع الأذان يوم الجمعة

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammati was-salatil-qa'imati, ati Muhammadan al-wasilata wal-fadilata wad-darajatar-rafi'ata wab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtah

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the Wasilah, the highest rank, and the elevated station, and raise him to the praised station that You have promised him.

virtues.en: An extended version of the dua between Adhan and Iqamah with additional requests for elevated rank. Jabir reported that the Prophet said: Whoever says this upon hearing the Adhan, my intercession becomes obligatory for him on the Day of Judgment. (Sahih al-Bukhari 614).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَىٰ سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi wa ala sunnati Rasulillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah and upon the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever performs ghusl on Friday, it is as if he offered a sacrifice. (Sahih al-Bukhari 881). The Friday ghusl is highly recommended for adults, beginning at dawn. It is one of the emphasized Sunnahs of Friday.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwatin

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any power or strength of mine.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever performs ghusl on Friday, puts on the best of his clothes, applies perfume if he has any, then goes for the Friday prayer and does not step over people, and prays what Allah has ordained for him, then listens silently... his sins between that Friday and the next Friday are forgiven. (Abu Dawud 1050, graded Hasan Sahih).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi, subhanallahil-azeem

translation.en: Glory be to Allah and all praise is His, glory be to Allah the Magnificent

virtues.en: It is recommended to engage in dhikr and dua before the Friday khutbah begins. The Prophet said: Whoever says Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 100 times, his sins will be forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea. (Sahih Muslim 2692).

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah (33x), Alhamdulillah (33x), Allahu Akbar (34x)

translation.en: Glory be to Allah (33x), All praise is for Allah (33x), Allah is the Greatest (34x)

virtues.en: After every obligatory prayer, including Friday, the Prophet prescribed saying SubhanAllah 33x, Alhamdulillah 33x, and Allahu Akbar 34x, completing 100. This expiates all minor sins. (Sahih Muslim 595).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir li wa tub alayya innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Raheem

translation.en: O Allah, forgive me and accept my repentance, indeed You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Merciful.

virtues.en: It is recommended to make abundant dua after the Friday prayer. The Prophet said: The closest a servant is to his Lord is during prostration, so increase your supplications. (Sahih Muslim 482). Friday is the best day for dua.

items.arabic: لَا يُصَامُ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَّا أَنْ يُصَامَ يَوْمٌ قَبْلَهُ أَوْ يَوْمٌ بَعْدَهُ
items.transliteration: La yusamu yawmul-jumu'ati illa an yusama yawmun qablahu aw yawmun ba'dah

translation.en: It is not permissible to fast only on Friday unless one also fasts the day before or after it.

virtues.en: The Prophet forbade fasting only on Friday, saying: None of you should fast on Friday unless he fasts a day before it or a day after it. (Sahih al-Bukhari 1985). This is a sunnah etiquette for Friday, not a dua, but important guidance.

items.arabic: آيَاتُ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ الْعَشْرُ الْأُخَرُ
items.transliteration: The last ten verses of Surah Al-Kahf

translation.en: The last ten verses of Surah Al-Kahf

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever memorizes ten verses from the beginning of Surah Al-Kahf, he will be protected from the Dajjal. (Sahih Muslim 809, graded Hasan by Al-Albani). In another narration: Whoever reads the last ten verses of Surah Al-Kahf, a light will shine for him. This adds another dimension of protection.

items.arabic: اقْرَأْ كِتَابَكَ
items.transliteration: Iqra kitabak

translation.en: Read your Book (Surah Al-Isra 17:14)

virtues.en: Friday has a special connection with Quran recitation. The Prophet would recite Surah Al-Jumu'ah (62) and Al-Munafiqun (63) in the Friday prayer. Reading the Quran on Friday carries special reward, and it is recommended to recite Surah Al-Kahf specifically. (Sahih Muslim 879).

title.en: Dua While the Imam Delivers Khutbah

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ
items.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir li wa tub alayya

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance.

virtues.en: While the imam is delivering the khutbah, it is recommended to listen silently. However, if the imam makes dua, the congregation should say Amin. Between the two khutbahs and during personal moments, one may make silent dua. The Prophet said: When the imam says Amin, say Amin, for whoever says Amin and it coincides with the angels' Amin, all his past sins will be forgiven. (Sahih al-Bukhari 783).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma taqabbal minna innaka Antas-Sami'ul-'Aleem

translation.en: O Allah, accept from us, indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

virtues.en: Friday is the best day to give charity. The Prophet said: The most beloved actions to Allah are those done most consistently, even if they are small. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6464). Combining charity with dua on Friday increases the likelihood of acceptance.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur

translation.en: O Allah, by Your grace we enter the morning, by Your grace we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

virtues.en: A comprehensive morning dua that is especially recommended on Friday, combining gratitude, reliance, and remembrance of the Hereafter. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3391, graded Hasan).

title.en: Dua for Forgiveness of All Sins on Friday

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana abduka wa ana ala ahdika wa wadika ma ista'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika alayya wa abu'u bithanbi faghfir li fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant

translation.en: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I adhere to Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sins. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

virtues.en: This is Sayyid al-Istighfar, the master of all supplications for forgiveness. The Prophet said: Whoever says this with conviction in the evening and dies, he enters Paradise. Saying it on Friday is especially meritorious. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6306).

title.en: Evening of Friday: Seeking Protection for the Night

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt and the domination of men.

virtues.en: A powerful comprehensive evening dua taught by the Prophet (Abu Dawud 1552, graded Hasan). Especially recommended on Friday evening to protect through the coming week.

description.en: Duas for Ramadan and fasting
description.ar: أدعية رمضان والصيام

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-iman...

translation.en: O Allah, bring it upon us with security and faith.
translation.ar: اللهم أهله علينا بالأمن والإيمان...

virtues.en: Recited upon seeing the Ramadan crescent.
virtues.ar: تقال عند رؤية هلال رمضان.

items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Dhahaba-z-zama', wabtallatil-'uruq, wa thabatal-ajru in sha'a-llah.

translation.en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed.
translation.ar: ذهب الظمأ وابتلت العروق وثبت الأجر إن شاء الله

virtues.en: Never refused at iftar.
virtues.ar: للصائم عند فطره دعوة لا ترد.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ كَرِيمٌ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun karimun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni.

translation.en: O Allah, indeed You are Pardoning, Generous; You love pardon, so pardon me.
translation.ar: اللهم إنك عفو كريم تحب العفو فاعف عني

virtues.en: Aisha asked what to say on Laylat al-Qadr. The Prophet ﷺ taught this.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يقولها في ليلة القدر.

items.notes: Narrated by Aisha.

title.en: Dua for Sighting the Ramadan Moon

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu alayna bil-amni wal-imani was-salamati wal-islami, Rabbi wa Rabbukallah

translation.en: O Allah, let this moon appear upon us with security, faith, safety, and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: When you see the crescent moon of Ramadan, say: O Allah, let it appear upon us with security, faith, safety, and Islam. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3451, graded Hasan). This is the prescribed dua upon sighting the Ramadan moon.

items.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: Dhahaba az-zama wa abtallatil-uruq wa thabatal-ajru insha Allah

translation.en: Thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Three people will not have their supplications rejected: the fasting person until he breaks his fast, the just ruler, and the oppressed. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3598, graded Hasan). This is the dua the Prophet made when breaking his fast. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2357).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah

translation.en: In the name of Allah

virtues.en: The Prophet said: When one of you breaks his fast, let him break it with dates. If he cannot find dates, then with water, for it is purifying. And say Bismillah. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2356, graded Hasan).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma barik lana fima razaqtana wa qina adhaban-nar

translation.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, bless us in what You have provided us and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: The blessing is in three things: the Jama'ah, the Suhoor, and the Iftar. (Sahih at-Tabarani, graded Sahih by Al-Albani). The pre-dawn meal is a blessed act and the dua at suhoor is accepted.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet's most frequent dua (Sahih Muslim 2721). Especially recommended during the last 10 nights of Ramadan when seeking Laylatul Qadr. (Quran 2:201).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as-alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Ask Allah for pardon and well-being, for no one is given pardon and well-being after which he would be given anything better. (Ibn Majah 3873, graded Sahih). This dua is especially powerful in Ramadan.

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْعِزَّةِ وَالْعَظَمَةِ وَالْهَيْبَةِ وَالْقُدْرَةِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْجَبَرُوتِ
items.transliteration: Subhana dhi mulki wal-malakuti, subhana dhi al-izzati wal-azamati wal-haybati wal-qudrati wal-kibrya-i wal-jabarut

translation.en: Glory be to the One who possesses the dominion and the kingdom. Glory be to the One who possesses majesty, greatness, reverence, power, pride, and authority.

virtues.en: This is the dua between every two rak'ahs of Tarawih prayer, attributed to Ali ibn Abi Talib (Musnad Ahmad 1337, graded Hasan). It is widely recited in Tarawih prayers across the Muslim world.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَىٰ رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma laka sumtu wa ala rizqika aftartu

translation.en: O Allah, for You I have fasted, and upon Your provision I have broken my fast.

virtues.en: This dua is made at iftar time, directing the act of fasting entirely to Allah. It affirms that fasting is for Allah's sake alone and breaking the fast is through His provision. (Abu Dawud 2358, graded Hasan by Al-Albani).

title.en: Dua for Spiritual Elevation in Ramadan

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْنَا رَمَضَانَ وَأَعِنَّا عَلَىٰ صِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma ballighna Ramadan wa a'inna ala siyamihi wa qiyamihi

translation.en: O Allah, let us reach Ramadan and help us to fast and pray in it.

virtues.en: This dua is made before Ramadan begins, asking Allah to grant life to witness the blessed month and to grant success in worshiping during it. (Musnad al-Bazzar, graded Hasan by Al-Albani).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal wal-jubni wal-bukhl wal-harami wa adhabil-qabr

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from weakness, laziness, cowardice, miserliness, old age, and the punishment of the grave.

virtues.en: The Prophet would frequently seek refuge from these six things (Sahih al-Bukhari 6367). Especially relevant in Ramadan when worship is demanding and Shaytan is chained, making one's own laziness the primary obstacle.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ عَلَيْنَا حِكْمَتَكَ وَانْشُرْ عَلَيْنَا رَحْمَتَكَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ftah alayna hikmataka wanshur alayna rahmataka ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram

translation.en: O Allah, open for us Your wisdom and spread Your mercy upon us, O Lord of Majesty and Generosity.

virtues.en: A beautiful dua before opening the Quran, especially recommended in Ramadan when Quran recitation is greatly emphasized. The Quran was revealed in Ramadan (Quran 2:185).

title.en: Dua for Completion of Quran in Ramadan

items.arabic: صَدَقَ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Sadaqallahu al-azeem

translation.en: Allah the Almighty has spoken the truth

virtues.en: Commonly said upon completing the recitation of the entire Quran. In Ramadan, completing the Quran is a common goal. While this exact phrase is not a hadith, it is a widespread scholarly practice. A more complete supplication after khatm includes: O Allah, through the Quran, honor us, and do not disgrace us. (Scholarly practice).

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir li wa tub alayya innaka Antat-Tawwabur-Raheem

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, for You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Most Merciful.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Three supplications are not rejected: the fasting person until he breaks his fast, the just ruler, and the oppressed. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3598). This means any dua made while fasting is accepted, so one should make abundant dua throughout the fasting day.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَرْنَا الْحَقَّ حَقًّا وَارْزُقْنَا اتِّبَاعَهُ وَأَرِنَا الْبَاطِلَ بَاطِلًا وَارْزُقْنَا اجْتِنَابَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma arinal-haqqa haqqan warzuqnattiba'ah wa arinal-batila batilan warzuqnajtinabah

translation.en: O Allah, show us the truth as truth and grant us its following, and show us falsehood as falsehood and grant us its avoidance.

virtues.en: A powerful dua for guidance during the last 10 nights of Ramadan. The Prophet taught this comprehensive supplication (Sahih Muslim 1924). It asks for three things simultaneously: recognizing truth, following it, recognizing falsehood, and avoiding it.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu anni

translation.en: O Allah, You are the Pardoner, You love to pardon, so pardon me.

virtues.en: Aisha said: When the last ten nights of Ramadan began, the Prophet would tighten his belt (i.e., exert himself in worship), pray throughout the night, and wake his family. (Sahih al-Bukhari 2024, Sahih Muslim 1174). The primary dua in these nights is the Laylatul Qadr dua.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا وَفِي عِظَامِي نُورًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma-j'al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran wa fi sam'i nuran wa fi izami nuran

translation.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing, and light in my bones.

virtues.en: Part of the longer dua for light (Sahih Muslim 763). Ramadan is described as the month of light (noor), so this dua aligns perfectly with its spirit. The Prophet sought light in every aspect of his being.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma taqabbal minna innaka Antas-Sami'ul-'Aleem

translation.en: O Allah, accept from us, indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

virtues.en: Zakat al-Fitr is obligatory before the Eid prayer. While there is no specific dua prescribed for giving it, this general dua of acceptance is appropriate when fulfilling this obligation. (Quran 2:127).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
items.transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar. La ilaha illallahu, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahil-hamd

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. There is no deity except Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and all praise is for Allah.

virtues.en: The prescribed takbirat to be recited from the night of Eid until the Eid prayer. The Prophet said: Beautify your Eid with takbir. (Sahih - agreed upon). The takbir begins after the last day of Ramadan.

items.arabic: تَقَبَّلَ اللَّهُ مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ
items.transliteration: Taqabbalallahu minna wa minkum

translation.en: May Allah accept from us and from you.

virtues.en: This is the greeting exchanged on Eid day. The companions would say to each other: Taqabbalallahu minna wa minkum (May Allah accept from us and from you). (Fath al-Bari). It is a sunnah to make abundant dua on Eid day.

title.en: Dua for Good Deeds Accepted in Ramadan

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الصَّائِمِينَ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْقَائِمِينَ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُتَقَبِّلِينَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-j'alna minas-sa'imeen wa-j'alna minal-qa'imeen wa-j'alna minal-mutaqabbaleen

translation.en: O Allah, make us among those who fast, make us among those who pray at night, and make us among those whose deeds are accepted.

virtues.en: A comprehensive dua asking for the highest level of success in Ramadan: not just performing the acts, but having them accepted. This is the ultimate fear of the righteous - that their deeds might not be accepted. (Quran 5:27 refers to this fear).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma a'idhni minan-nar

translation.en: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever seeks refuge from the Fire seven times, the Fire will say: O Allah, save him from me. (Sahih at-Tirmidhi 2572, graded Hasan). Ramadan is the month of salvation from the Fire, as the gates of Hell are closed.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as-alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek Your protection from the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever asks Allah for Paradise three times, Paradise says: O Allah, admit him. And whoever seeks refuge from the Fire three times, the Fire says: O Allah, save him. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 2572, graded Hasan).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ صَدَقَتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهَا حِجَابًا مِنَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma taqabbal sadaqatana waj'alha hijaban minan-nar

translation.en: O Allah, accept our charity and make it a barrier between us and the Fire.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Charity extinguishes sin as water extinguishes fire. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 614, graded Hasan). In Ramadan, the reward for charity is multiplied, so combining charity with dua is especially meritorious.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahilladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana muslimeen

translation.en: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Allah is pleased with His servant when he eats and praises Him for it, and when he drinks and praises Him for it. (Sahih Muslim 2734). Especially meaningful at iftar after a long day of fasting.

title.en: Dua for Breaking Habits in Ramadan

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيَّ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قَلْبِي وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيَّ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma habbib ilayyal-imana wa zayyinnhu fi qalbi wa karrih ilayyal-kufra wal-fusuqa wal-'isyana

translation.en: O Allah, make faith beloved to me and beautify it in my heart, and make disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience hateful to me.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: O Allah, make faith beloved to me and beautify it in my heart. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6366). Ramadan is the ideal time for this dua as it provides a break from normal habits and a chance to build better ones.

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah innaka sami'ud-du'a'

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a goodly offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.

virtues.en: The dua of Zakariya (Quran 3:38). Ramadan is a time of family bonding through iftar, suhoor, and tarawih. This Quranic dua for righteous family is especially fitting. (Quran 3:38).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma Rabbana lakal-hamdu anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardi

translation.en: O Allah, our Lord, to You is all praise. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth.

virtues.en: The Prophet would begin his night prayer with this comprehensive dua of praise (Sahih al-Bukhari 1120). In Ramadan, Qiyam al-Layl (Tarawih/Tahajjud) is especially emphasized.

items.arabic: نَوَيْتُ الصَّوْمَ غَدًا أَدَاءً لِفَرْضِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ هٰذِهِ السَّنَةِ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ
items.transliteration: Nawaytus-sawma ghadan ada-an lifaridi shahri Ramadan hadhihis-sanati lillahi ta'ala

translation.en: I intend to fast tomorrow, performing the obligation of this month of Ramadan this year, for Allah the Exalted.

virtues.en: The niyyah (intention) for fasting must be made each night before Fajr. While this is the standard intention formula, one can also make a more heartfelt dua: O Allah, I intend to fast for You tomorrow, so accept it from me and make it easy for me.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَحْرُومِينَ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدَيْنَا وَلِلْمُسْلِمِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma la taj'alna minal-mahroomeen waghfir lana wa liwalidayna wal-muslimeena yawma yaqumul-hisab

translation.en: O Allah, do not make us among the deprived, and forgive us and our parents and all the Muslims on the Day of Reckoning.

virtues.en: As Ramadan draws to a close, this dua expresses the fear of being deprived of its blessings despite one's efforts. It also extends forgiveness to parents and the entire Muslim community. A beautiful comprehensive closing supplication.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as-alukal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.

virtues.en: For those unable to fast due to illness, travel, or other valid reasons. They should make up the fast later and make dua. The Prophet said: Ask Allah for "al-'afiyah" (well-being) for no one has been given anything better than well-being after certainty. (Sahih Ibn Majah 3873).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani wal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-bukhli wal-jubni wa dal'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt, and the domination of men.

virtues.en: The Prophet sought refuge from these six things (Abu Dawud 1552). During Itikaf in the last 10 nights, this dua is especially relevant as one isolates to focus purely on worship and connection with Allah.

description.en: Duas for Hajj and Umrah
description.ar: أدعية الحج والعمرة

items.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
items.transliteration: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.

translation.en: Here I am at Your service, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Truly, all praise and bounty are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partner.
translation.ar: لبيك اللهم لبيك...

virtues.en: Said when entering ihram.
virtues.ar: تقال عند الإحرام.

items.notes: Narrated by Abdullah bin Umar.

items.arabic:
إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Innas-Safa wal-Marwata min sha'a'irillah / La ilaha illa-llahu wahdahu la sharika lah...

translation.en: Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. / There is no deity except Allah alone...
translation.ar: إن الصفا والمروة من شعائر الله...

virtues.en: Recited when beginning Sa'i.
virtues.ar: تقال عند بدء السعي.

items.notes: Narrated by Jabir.

title.en: The Best Dua of the Day of Arafah

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

translation.en: There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is able to do all things.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهو على كل شيء قدير.

reference.narrator: Amr ibn Shu'ayb, from his father, from his grandfather

virtues.en: "The best supplication is the supplication of the Day of Arafah, and the best of what the Prophets before me and I have said is: ..." — the essence of Arafah.

title.en: Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhab an-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار.

reference.grading: Established (recited by the Prophet ﷺ in tawaf; Muslim)

virtues.en: Recited between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone during tawaf, as reported from the Prophet's ﷺ tawaf (Muslim 1218); the verse is Qur'an 2:201.

title.en: Takbir of the Days of Dhul-Hijjah

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha illa Allah, wallahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillah al-hamd.

translation.en: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there is no deity but Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, and to Allah belongs all praise.
translation.ar: الله أكبر، الله أكبر، لا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر، الله أكبر، ولله الحمد.

reference.collection: Sunan al-Bayhaqi / Musannaf Ibn Abi Shaybah
reference.grading: Athar (practice of the Companions; the sunnah of loud takbir from Fajr of Arafah day is in al-Bukhari 969)

virtues.en: The unrestrained takbir chanted through the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah, from Fajr on the Day of Arafah until Asr on the final tashreeq day.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.

translation.en: Say "Allahu akbar" with each pebble thrown at each jamarah.
translation.ar: الله أكبر.

virtues.en: Established from the Prophet's ﷺ stoning: takbir with every pebble, seven pebbles per pillar.

title.en: Salutations Upon the Prophet in Madinah

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka hamidun majid.

translation.en: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
translation.ar: اللهم صل على محمد وعلى آل محمد كما صليت على إبراهيم وعلى آل إبراهيم إنك حميد مجيد.

virtues.en: Abundant salawat — especially with the Ibrahimic form — when visiting the Prophet's mosque and standing before his resting place.

description.en: Duas for protection from evil, jinn, and harm
description.ar: أدعية الحماية من الشر والجن والأذى

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
translation.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق

virtues.en: Protection from all harm.
virtues.ar: حماية من كل شيء.

items.notes: Narrated by Khawlah bint Hakim.

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ، مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَذَرَأَ وَبَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ طَوَارِقِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقًا يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati allati la yujawizuhunna barrun wa la fajir...

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, which neither the righteous nor the wicked can surpass...
translation.ar: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات...

virtues.en: Comprehensive protection.
virtues.ar: تعويذة شاملة.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ سَمْعِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ بَصَرِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ لِسَانِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ قَلْبِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَنِيِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri sam'i, wa min sharri basari, wa min sharri lisani, wa min sharri qalbi, wa min sharri maniyyi.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of my hearing, my sight, my tongue, my heart, and my lust.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر سمعي...

virtues.en: Protection for all body parts.
virtues.ar: تعوذ للجوارح.

items.notes: Narrated by Anas.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-kasali wal-haram, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from cowardice, laziness, and old age. I seek refuge in You from the trials of life and death. And I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الجبن...

virtues.en: Recited frequently by the Prophet ﷺ.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يتعوذ بهن.

items.notes: Narrated by Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matika, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatika, wa fuja'ati niqmatika, wa jami'i sakhatik.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the loss of well-being, the sudden onset of Your punishment, and all of Your displeasure.

virtues.en: The Prophet taught this comprehensive protection supplication covering four types of calamity. (Sahih Muslim 2739).

title.en: Refuge from Evil Eye and Envy

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hamma, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

virtues.en: The Prophet used to seek this refuge for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3371). Ibrahim used to seek refuge with these same words for Ismail and Ishaq.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm.

translation.en: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise except death. (Sunan an-Nasa'i 994). It is also said that nothing over you which does not have the permission of Allah if you say it morning and evening.

items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq... Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak... Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Do you not see that verses were revealed to me tonight the like of which has not been seen before? They are Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas. (Sahih Muslim 814). He also said: When you go to bed, recite them, for they will be sufficient for you. (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).

items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwallahu Ahad.

translation.en: Say: He is Allah, the One.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas, morning and evening, will be sufficient for you against everything. (Sahih Abi Dawud 5082). These three surahs are called Al-Mu'awwidhat (the ones of seeking refuge).

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru ma asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Aleem.

translation.en: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heavens, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever says this, nothing will harm him. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5088, Tirmidhi 3388, graded Sahih). This is one of the most powerful protection supplications.

title.en: Refuge from Shaytan and His Allies

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.

translation.en: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan.

virtues.en: The foundational refuge commanded by Allah in the Quran: When you recite the Quran, seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan. (Quran 16:98). This is also recited before every prayer and before every wudu.

title.en: Refuge from 4 Things: Poverty, Temptation, Misfortune, and Injustice

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani wal-'ajzi wal-kasali wal-bukhli wal-jubni wa dal'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debt and the domination of men.

virtues.en: The Prophet frequently made this comprehensive refuge (Sunan Abi Dawud 1552, graded Hasan). It covers six categories of harm: emotional (anxiety, sorrow), physical (weakness, laziness), financial (debt, miserliness), social (domination), and spiritual (cowardice).

items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'arshil-'Azeem.

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Noble Throne.

virtues.en: Ibrahim said this when thrown into the fire. The Prophet said: Whoever says this seven times morning and evening, Allah will suffice him for everything that concerns him. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5083, graded Sahih).

title.en: Refuge from Punishment of the Grave

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabri wa min 'adhabi jahannam wa min fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat wa min sharri fitnatil-masihid-dajjal.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hell, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil trial of the False Messiah.

virtues.en: The Prophet commanded his companions to seek refuge from these four things after every prayer. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6375, Sahih Muslim 588).

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
items.transliteration: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi Rabbil-ʿālamīn. Ar-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Māliki yawmid-dīn. Iyyāka naʿbudu wa iyyāka nastaʿīn. Ihdināṣ-Ṣirāṭal-Mustaqīm. Ṣirāṭalladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim, ghayril-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim walāḍ-ḍāllīn.

translation.en: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us on the Straight Path — the path of those You have blessed, not of those who incurred Your wrath, nor of those who have gone astray.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ approved the use of Al-Fatihah as a ruqyah when a group of Companions cured a man stung by a scorpion by reciting it over him, saying: "You have done well; the best thing you used as medicine is the ruqyah." It is called Umm al-Quran and contains the essence of the entire Quran — a complete cure for spiritual and physical ailments when recited with sincerity and conviction.

title.en: Ayat al-Kursi — The Verse of the Throne

items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm. Lā ta'khudhuhū sinatun wa lā nawm. Lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ. Man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā bi-idhnih. Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bishay'imin ʿilmihī illā bimā shā'. Wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa, wa lā ya'ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm.

translation.en: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi when he lies down, there will remain with him a guardian from Allah, and no devil will approach him until morning." Its recitation is a powerful protection against jinn, evil eye, and all forms of spiritual harm. Scholars include it as a core verse in every ruqyah session.

title.en: Last Two Verses of Al-Baqarah — Sufficiency and Protection

items.arabic:
آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۚ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Āmanar-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rabbihī wal-mu'minūn. Kullun āmana billāhi wa malā'ikatihī wa kutubihī wa rusulih, lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min rusulih. Wa qālū samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā, ghufrānaka rabbanā wa ilaykal-maṣīr. Lā yukalliful-lāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā, lahā mā kasabat wa ʿalayhā maktasabat. Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhaṭ'nā, rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū ʿalalladhīna min qablinā, rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿannā waghfir lanā warḥamnā, anta mawlānā fanṣurnā ʿalal-qawmil-kāfirīn.

translation.en: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, saying: "We have heard and we have obeyed. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination." Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever recites the two verses at the end of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will be sufficient for him." These verses contain a comprehensive supplication for forgiveness, ease, and protection — making them ideal for ruqyah against spiritual afflictions, anxiety, and overwhelming difficulties.

title.en: Reciting Surah Al-Baqarah — Driving Away the Devil
title.ar: تِلَاوَةُ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ كَامِلَةً — طَرْدُ الشَّيْطَانِ

items.arabic: سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ كَامِلَةً
items.transliteration: Sūratul-Baqarah kāmilah.

translation.en: Surah Al-Baqarah in its entirety (286 verses).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not make your houses like graves. The Shaytan flees from a house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited." In another narration: "Recite Surah Al-Baqarah, for to take recourse to it is a blessing and to give it up is a cause of grief, and the sorcerers cannot overcome it." The full recitation of this surah is one of the most powerful remedies for magic (sihr), jinn possession, and evil eye — it acts as a complete spiritual shield for the home and its occupants.

items.arabic:
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwallāhu aḥad. Allāhuṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakul-lahū kufuwan aḥad.

translation.en: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: "By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, it (Surah Al-Ikhlas) is equivalent to one-third of the Quran." Reciting it once is the minimum in ruqyah. It affirms Allah's absolute oneness (Tawhid) — the strongest weapon against all forms of shirk-based spiritual harm including magic and jinn worship.

items.arabic:
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Qul aʿūdhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.

virtues.en: This surah is one of the two Mu'awwidhatayn (seeking refuge) revealed specifically for protection. The Prophet ﷺ recited it over himself during illness. The reference to "blowers in knots" (an-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad) directly addresses those who practice magic, making it the primary Quranic weapon against sihr (black magic).

items.arabic:
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul aʿūdhu birabbin-nās. Malikin-nās. Ilāhin-nās. Min sharril-waswāsil-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās. Minal-jinnati wan-nās.

translation.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers [evil] in the breasts of mankind. From among the jinn and mankind.

virtues.en: The final surah of the Quran, specifically revealed for seeking protection from the whisperings of Shaytan — both from jinn and humans. In ruqyah, it is essential for treating jinn possession, waswas (obsessive whispers), and spiritual afflictions caused by unseen entities. The Prophet ﷺ consistently included it in his ruqyah practice.

title.en: Quran 17:82 — The Quran as Healing and Mercy

items.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا هُوَ شِفَاءٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
items.transliteration: Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'āni mā huwa shifā'un wa raḥmatul lil-mu'minīn, wa lā yazīduẓ-ẓālimīna illā khasārā.

translation.en: And We send down of the Quran that which is healing and mercy to the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.

virtues.en: This foundational verse establishes the Quran itself as a source of healing (shifa) and mercy (rahmah). Scholars cite this as the primary proof-text that Quranic recitation is a legitimate and powerful form of ruqyah. The Prophet ﷺ and the Companions practiced Quran-based ruqyah based on this divine promise.

items.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
items.transliteration: Wa idhā mariḍtu fahuwa yashfīn.

translation.en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

virtues.en: A concise yet powerful declaration by Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) affirming that all healing comes from Allah alone. This verse is recommended to be recited during ruqyah to strengthen one's conviction (yaqin) that the true Healer is Allah. It shifts the heart from reliance on medicine alone to complete trust (tawakkul) in the Healer of all healers.

items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa lilladhīna āmanū hudan wa shifā'ḥ.

translation.en: Say: It is for those who believe, a guidance and a healing.

virtues.en: This verse specifies that the Quran functions as both guidance (huda) and healing (shifa) — but specifically for those who believe. The condition of faith (iman) is emphasized, indicating that the efficacy of Quranic ruqyah is connected to the sincerity and conviction of the one reciting and the one being treated.

title.en: Quran 10:57 — Healing for What is in the Breasts

items.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَتْكُم مَّوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَشِفَاءٌ لِّمَا فِي الصُّدُورِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
items.transliteration: Yā ayyuhān-nāsu qad jā'atkum mawʿiẓatun min rabbikum wa shifā'ul limā fis-ṣudūr, wa hudan wa raḥmatul lil-mu'minīn.

translation.en: O mankind, there has come to you an instruction from your Lord and a healing for what is in the breasts — and guidance and mercy for the believers.

virtues.en: This verse highlights that the Quran heals diseases of the heart (sadar) — including anxiety, grief, envy, doubt, and spiritual darkness. It is particularly relevant for ruqyah aimed at psychological and spiritual ailments, not just physical ones. The word "sadar" (breasts/chests) encompasses both the physical heart and the spiritual heart.

title.en: Quran 6:17 — None Removes Harm Except Allah
title.ar: مَا يَفْتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ (الأنْعَامِ: ١٧)

items.arabic: وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ وَإِن يَمْسَسْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Wa in yamsaska Allāhu bi-ḍurrin fa lā kāshifa lahu illā huwa, wa in yamsaska bi-khayrin fahuwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr.

translation.en: And if Allah should touch you with adversity, there is no remover of it except Him; and if He touches you with good — for He is over all things competent.

virtues.en: A powerful verse affirming that only Allah can remove harm and affliction. It is recited in ruqyah to reinforce the belief that all cure comes from Allah alone. When a person is afflicted by magic, evil eye, jinn, or any illness, this verse reminds them that the ultimate source of relief is their Lord.

title.en: Quran 7:155 — Prophet Musa's Dua for Forgiveness and Mercy

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا عَلَيْهِ رَحْمَتُكَ أَنتَ الْوَلِيُّ الْفَتَّاحُ
items.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā bimā faʿalas-sufahā'u minnā waghfir lanā ʿalayhi raḥmatuka, antal-waliyyul-fatṭāḥ.

translation.en: Our Lord, do not hold us accountable for what the foolish among us have done, and forgive us. Upon You is our mercy. You are the Protector, the Bestower.

virtues.en: After the Samiri led the Israelites astray with the golden calf, Prophet Musa (peace be upon him) made this humble supplication. It is recommended in ruqyah for those who may have been afflicted due to sins or spiritual negligence. Seeking forgiveness (istighfar) is a key component of spiritual healing, and this Quranic dua models the proper approach.

title.en: Quran 21:83 — Prophet Ayyub's Dua for Healing

items.arabic: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Wa Ayyūba idh nādā rabbahū annī massaniyaḍ-ḍurru wa anta arḥamur-rāḥimīn.

translation.en: And [remember] Ayyub (Job), when he called to his Lord: "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful."

virtues.en: One of the most beautiful and concise healing duas in the Quran. Prophet Ayyub (peace be upon him) was afflicted with severe illness for many years, and this short but deeply sincere dua was the means of his healing. The Prophet ﷺ recommended this dua for those suffering from prolonged illness. It teaches that acknowledging one's affliction and appealing to Allah's mercy is the key to healing.

title.en: Quran 23:118 — Forgiveness and the Best of Mercy

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanā warḥamnā wa anta khayrur-rāḥimīn.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of those who show mercy.

virtues.en: A beautiful comprehensive dua at the end of Surah Al-Mu'minun, combining the request for forgiveness (maghfirah) with mercy (rahmah). In ruqyah, it serves as a closing supplication after reciting the Quranic verses — seeking Allah's forgiveness for any shortcomings and His mercy for complete healing. The affirmation that Allah is "the best of those who show mercy" strengthens the heart's hope.

title.en: Quran 16:69 — Healing in What the Bees Produce

items.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Yakhruju min buṭūnihā sharābun mukhtalifun alwānuhu fīhi shifā'ul lin-nās.

translation.en: From their bellies comes a drink of varying colors, in which there is healing for mankind.

virtues.en: This verse highlights honey as a divinely ordained healing substance. It is significant in ruqyah because: (1) It affirms that Allah has placed cures in His creation, and (2) Honey is often used as a medium for ruqyah — Quranic verses are recited over honey, which is then consumed by the patient. This combines spiritual healing (Quranic recitation) with physical healing (the medicinal properties of honey).

title.en: The Ruqyah of Jibril — The Angelic Cure

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنٍ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
items.transliteration: Bismillāhi arqīka, min kulli shay'in yu'dhīka, min sharri kulli nafsin aw ʿaynin ḥāsid. Allāhu yashfīka, bismillāhi arqīka.

translation.en: In the Name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you; in the Name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.

virtues.en: This is the ruqyah that the Angel Jibril (peace be upon him) taught to the Prophet ﷺ to use for healing. It is considered the most authentic and complete prophetic ruqyah formula. It specifically mentions protection from every harmful thing, from evil souls, and from the evil eye (hasad). The repetition of "Bismillahi arqika" at the beginning and end frames the ruqyah entirely in Allah's name.

title.en: Asking Allah the Great, Lord of the Throne to Heal
title.ar: سُؤَالُ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الشِّفَاءَ

items.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
items.transliteration: As'alullāhal-ʿaẓīma Rabbal-ʿArshil-ʿaẓīm an yashfīka.

translation.en: I ask Allah the Great, Lord of the Great Throne, to heal you.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ visited a sick person and made this dua for him. It is one of the most powerful and comprehensive healing supplications, invoking Allah by His greatest attributes — "Al-Azim" (the Great) and "Rabb al-Arsh al-Azim" (Lord of the Great Throne). Scholars consider it among the most effective duas for the sick and include it in every ruqyah session.

title.en: Lord of Mankind — Remove the Harm and Heal

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.transliteration: Allāhumma rabban-nāsi, adhhibil-ba's, ishfihi wa antash-shāfī, lā shifā'a illā shifā'uka, shifā'an lā yughādiru saqamā.

translation.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction. Heal (him/her), for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness behind.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ would visit his family members when they were ill, wipe them with his right hand, and say this dua. It is the most frequently cited prophetic ruqyah for the sick. The phrase "a healing that leaves no illness behind" (shifa'an la yughadiru saqama) is a comprehensive request for complete and permanent recovery. Scholars unanimously recommend it for all types of illness.

title.en: Seeking Refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah

items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmah, min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli ʿaynin lāmmah.

translation.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ used this dua to seek protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn. He would say: "I seek refuge for both of you in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every evil eye." The phrase "perfect words" (kalimatillahit-tammah) refers to the Quran and every word of Allah that is complete and flawless. It is one of the most comprehensive protection duas.

title.en: Ruqyah for Pain — Place Hand and Recite Seven Times
title.ar: رُقْيَةُ الوَجَعِ — وَضْعُ اليَدِ وَالتَّكْرَارُ سَبْعًا

items.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا)
