items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 77

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطِلْ حَيَاتِي، وَاغْفِرْ ذَنْبِي

reference.notes: See original source for full citation.

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 77

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَائِمًا، وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ قَاعِدًا، وَاحْفَظْنِي بِالْإِسْلَامِ رَاقِدًا، وَلَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوًّا حَاسِدًا

reference.notes: See original source for full citation.

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 77

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْنَا وَلَا تَنْقُصْنَا، وَأَكْرِمْنَا وَلَا تُهِنَّا، وَأَعْطِنَا وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا، وَآثِرْنَا وَلَا تُؤْثِرْ عَلَيْنَا، وَأَرْضِنَا وَارْضَ عَنَّا

reference.notes: See original source for full citation.

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 78

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ

reference.notes: Also in Abu Dawud, Nasa'i 1522. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Shall I not guide you to the best of your deeds...? Say: Allahumma a'inna 'ala shukrika wa dhikrika wa husni 'ibadatik.'

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 78

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَسِّرْ لِي جَلِيسًا صَالِحًا

reference.notes: Also in Muslim 6278

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 78

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْنِي إِلَى عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَحَبِّبْ إِلَيَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

reference.notes: Abu Hurairah asked the Prophet ﷺ to supplicate that he and his mother be made beloved to Allah's believing servants, and that the believers be made beloved to them. The Prophet made this dua.

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 78

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْنِي، وَاجْعَلْنِي هَادِيًا مَهْدِيًّا

reference.notes: Also in Muslim 3035. The Prophet ﷺ struck Jarir's chest with his hand and supplicated with this after Jarir complained of not being steady on horseback.

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 79

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَبْ لِي نَفْسًا مُطْمَئِنَّةً إِلَيْكَ

reference.notes: By Ibn al-Qayyim

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 79

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِزَّنِي بِطَاعَتِكَ، وَلَا تُذِلَّنِي بِمَعْصِيَتِكَ

reference.notes: By Ibn al-Qayyim

items.notes: Source: من يدعوني؟ by Dr. Turki al-Maiman, Chapter 15, page 79

description.en: Duas asking Allah for guidance, righteousness and steadfastness on the straight path.
description.ar: أدعية تسأل الله الهداية والتقوى والثبات على الصراط المستقيم.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَرِنَا الْحَقَّ حَقًّا وَارْزُقْنَا اتِّبَاعَهُ، وَأَرِنَا الْبَاطِلَ بَاطِلًا وَارْزُقْنَا اجْتِنَابَهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma arinal-haqqa haqqan warzuqnattiba'ah, wa arinal-batila batilan warzuqnajtinabah.

translation.en: O Allah, show us the truth as truth and grant us the ability to follow it. And show us falsehood as falsehood and grant us the ability to avoid it.

virtues.en: One of the most important duas for guidance. It asks for three things: recognizing truth, following it, recognizing falsehood, and avoiding it. (Sahih Muslim 1924).

items.arabic: اِهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ
items.transliteration: Ihdinas-Siratal Mustaqeem.

translation.en: Guide us to the straight path.

virtues.en: From Surah Al-Fatihah, recited at least 17 times daily in prayers. It is the most frequently recited dua in the Muslim's life, asking for guidance to the straight path in every prayer. (Quran 1:6).

title.en: O Allah, Show Me the Truth in Disputes

items.arabic: رَبِّ بَسَطْتَ لِي شَيْئًا وَبِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbi basatta li shay-an wa bikulli shay-in qadeer.

translation.en: My Lord, You have granted me something and You have power over everything.

virtues.en: The dua of Prophet Dawud. When we face disputes, we should ask Allah to show us the truth and give us the ability to follow it. (Quran 38:35). This dua is for when you need to make a difficult decision.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

virtues.en: The most frequently used dua of the Prophet. Anas reported it was the most the Prophet would supplicate with. (Sahih Muslim 2721). It is the most comprehensive dua for all-round well-being.

items.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilman.

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

virtues.en: The Quranic dua for knowledge (Quran 20:114). Even as a prophet, Musa asked for more knowledge. This dua should be recited before studying, reading, or seeking any form of beneficial knowledge.

title.en: O Allah, Benefit Me With What You Taught Me

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Allahummanfa'ni bima 'allamtani wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni wa zidni 'ilman.

translation.en: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

virtues.en: The Prophet used to supplicate this. (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3599, graded Hasan). Emphasizes three crucial aspects: practical benefit from existing knowledge, seeking new beneficial knowledge, and continuous growth.

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri wa yassir li amri.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task.

virtues.en: The dua of Musa before facing Pharaoh (Quran 20:25-26). Recommended before any difficult task, exam, interview, or challenging situation.

title.en: Make Us Leaders of the Righteous

items.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.transliteration: Waj'alna lilmuttaqeena imama.

translation.en: And make us leaders of the righteous.

virtues.en: The dua of Ibrahim (Quran 25:74). It asks not just for personal righteousness but to be a leader and example for others. One of the most selfless duas in the Quran.

description.en: Duas for patience during trials, hardship and grief, seeking Allah's help and relief.
description.ar: أدعية للصبر أثناء الابتلاء والشدة والحزن، وطلب عون الله وفرجه.

items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa Rabbul-'arshil-'Azeem.

translation.en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no deity except Him. Upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Noble Throne.

virtues.en: Ibrahim said this when thrown into the fire. The Prophet said: Whoever says this when anxious or distressed, Allah will suffice him. (Sunan Abi Dawud 5019).

title.en: O Allah, I Seek Refuge from Grief
title.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الهم والحزن

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِي حُكْمِكَ عَدْلٌ فِي قَضَائِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduka ibnu 'abdika ibnu amatika nasiyati biyadika, madin fi hukmika, 'adlun fi qada'ika.

translation.en: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your female servant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just.

virtues.en: The most comprehensive dua for afflictions, known as the dua of distress (dua'u al-karb). The Prophet said: No one ever supplicates with this for a matter except that Allah responds to it. (Musnad Ahmad 3712, graded Sahih by Al-Albani).

items.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Anni massaniyad-durru wa Anta arhamur-rahimeen.

translation.en: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

virtues.en: Ayyub suffered for years but remained patient. His brief dua was answered immediately and Allah restored his health, family, and wealth. (Quran 21:83).

title.en: When Something Is Lost or Afflicted

items.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
items.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, Allahumma-jurni fi musibati, wa akhlif li khayran minha.

translation.en: We belong to Allah and to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better.
translation.ar: إنا لله وإنا إليه راجعون اللهم أجرني في مصيبتي وأخلف لي خيرًا منها.

virtues.en: For every loss — not only death: health, wealth, work, relationships. Allah promised better in exchange for the patient supplication.

title.en: When You See Another Afflicted — Gratitude Dua

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi alladhi 'afani mimma ibtalaka bihi, wa faddalani 'ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila.

translation.en: Praise be to Allah who has spared me what He has afflicted you with, and preferred me above many of His creation.
translation.ar: الحمد لله الذي عافاني مما ابتلاك به وفضلني على كثير ممن خلق تفضيلًا.

reference.grading: Hasan (at-Tirmidhi; elevated to sahih by others)

virtues.en: Said silently upon seeing someone tested with illness or hardship — gratitude that guards against pride and heals envy.

description.en: Duas to strengthen faith, increase certainty and protect against doubt.
description.ar: أدعية لتقوية الإيمان وزيادة اليقين والحماية من الشكوك.

title.en: O Allah, Make Faith Beloved to Me

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيَّ الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قَلْبِي وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيَّ الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma habbib ilayyal-imana wa zayyinnhu fi qalbi wa karrih ilayyal-kufra wal-fusuqa wal-'isyana.

translation.en: O Allah, make faith beloved to me and beautify it in my heart, and make disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience hateful to me.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: O Allah, make faith beloved to me and beautify it in my heart. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6366).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ زِدْنِي إِيمَانًا وَيَقِينًا وَاتِّبَاعًا لِمَا تَرْضَىٰ
items.transliteration: Allahumma zidni imanan wa yaqeenan wittiba'an lima tarda.

translation.en: O Allah, increase me in faith, certainty, and adherence to what pleases You.

virtues.en: A comprehensive dua for strengthening all three pillars of the heart's certainty: knowledge (ilm), conviction (yaqeen), and action (amal). (Musnad Ahmad, graded Hasan by Al-Albani).

items.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ
items.transliteration: Ya muqallibal-qulubi thabbit qalbi ala dinik.

translation.en: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Hearts are between two of Allah's fingers — He changes them as He wills. He used to say: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6641, Sahih Muslim 2654).

description.en: Words of gratitude and praise to Allah for His countless blessings.
description.ar: كلمات الشكر والثناء على الله على نعمه التي لا تحصى.

items.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alameen.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.

virtues.en: The opening of the Quran and the most fundamental expression of gratitude. The Prophet said: No servant says Alhamdulillah except that it fills the scales. (Sahih Muslim 2735).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُحْمَدَ بِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu kama yanbaghi an yuhmada bika.

translation.en: O Allah, to You is all praise as it should be offered in accordance with Your majesty.

virtues.en: This is from the dua of the Prophet during his bowing (Sahih Muslim 483). The scholars said this means: praise that is fitting for Your greatness. It is the highest form of gratitude.

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَىٰ رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma laka sumtu wa ala rizqika aftartu.

translation.en: O Allah, for You I have fasted, and upon Your provision I have broken my fast.

virtues.en: This expresses complete gratitude and dependence on Allah. (Sunan Abi Dawud 2358, graded Hasan).

description.en: Supplications before, during and after ablution (wudu).
description.ar: أدعية قبل الوضوء وأثناءه وبعده.

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.

translation.en: In the name of Allah.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: There is no wudu for the one who does not mention the name of Allah upon it. (Sunan Abi Dawud 101, graded Sahih). Starting every act with Bismillah brings barakah and distinguishes the act as worship.

title.en: Dua After Wudu — The Eight Gates of Paradise

items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَن لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh.

translation.en: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah alone, He has no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.

virtues.en: The Prophet said: Whoever performs wudu and then says this, the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him and he may enter through whichever one he wishes. (Sahih Muslim 234).

items.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا
items.transliteration: Allahummaj'al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran wa fi sam'i nuran.

translation.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, and light in my hearing.

virtues.en: Part of a longer dua of the Prophet. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6316). It asks for spiritual illumination that makes the prayer, the Quran, and all worship more meaningful and impactful.

description.en: A curated set of duas for certainty, peace and trust in Allah.
description.ar: مجموعة مختارة من الأدعية لليقين والسكينة والتوكل على الله.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma antas-Salamu wa minkas-Salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.

translation.en: O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You comes all peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.
translation.ar: اللهم أنت السلام ومنك السلام تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام

virtues.en: True sakinah is a gift from Allah that descends when a person turns to Him with sincerity.
virtues.ar: True sakinah is a gift from Allah that descends when a person turns to Him with sincerity.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَرْشِدْنِي وَأَرْشِدْ بِي وَاجْعَلْنِي لَكَ مُسْلِمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma arshidni wa arshid bihi waj'alni laka musliman.

translation.en: O Allah, guide me and guide through me. Make me submitted to You.
translation.ar: اللهم أرشدني وأرشد بي واجعلني لك مسلما

virtues.en: This dua asks for personal guidance AND guidance through others.
virtues.ar: This dua asks for personal guidance AND guidance through others.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma ij'al fi qalbi nuran wa fi basari nuran wa fi sam'i nuran.

translation.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my sight, light in my hearing.
translation.ar: اللهم اجعل في قلبي نورا وفي بصري نورا وفي سمعي نورا

virtues.en: A comprehensive request for light representing a desire for divine guidance to permeate every aspect of existence.
virtues.ar: A comprehensive request for light representing a desire for divine guidance to permeate every aspect of existence.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana.

translation.en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا

virtues.en: The heart is like a ship needing constant steering. Guidance is a gift that must be maintained.
virtues.ar: The heart is like a ship needing constant steering. Guidance is a gift that must be maintained.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana zhalamna anfusana wa il lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy, we will be among the losers.
translation.ar: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين

virtues.en: Acknowledging wrongdoing is the first step to genuine repentance.
virtues.ar: Acknowledging wrongdoing is the first step to genuine repentance.

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri wa yassir li amri.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task.
translation.ar: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري

virtues.en: Musa (AS) made this dua before confronting Pharaoh, asking for internal capacity and external ease.
virtues.ar: Musa (AS) made this dua before confronting Pharaoh, asking for internal capacity and external ease.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. I have been among the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

virtues.en: The dua of Yunus from the whale. The Prophet said every Muslim in distress who recites it will be answered.
virtues.ar: The dua of Yunus from the whale. The Prophet said every Muslim in distress who recites it will be answered.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi ala kulli hal.

translation.en: All praise is for Allah in all circumstances.
translation.ar: الحمد لله على كل حال

virtues.en: Scholars note that gratitude in hardship is a higher station than gratitude in ease.
virtues.ar: Scholars note that gratitude in hardship is a higher station than gratitude in ease.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ شَيْئًا وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min an ushrika bika shay'an wa ana a'lam, wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lam.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowingly associating partners with You, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do not know.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من أن أشرك بك شيئا وأنا أعلم وأستغفرك لما لا أعلم

virtues.en: This dua guards against both open and hidden shirk, the minor shirk of showing off that the Prophet feared most for his ummah.
virtues.ar: This dua guards against both open and hidden shirk, the minor shirk of showing off that the Prophet feared most for his ummah.

items.arabic: رَبِّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah.

translation.en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after guidance and grant us mercy from You.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا وهب لنا من لدنك رحمة

virtues.en: Ibn al-Qayyim wrote that the greatest fitnah is the fitnah of the heart. This dua is the shield against spiritual deviation.
virtues.ar: Ibn al-Qayyim wrote that the greatest fitnah is the fitnah of the heart. This dua is the shield against spiritual deviation.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاكْفِنَا بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummar-zuqna halalan tayyiban wak-fina bihalalika an haramik.

translation.en: O Allah, provide us with lawful, good provision, and suffice us with Your halal from Your haram.
translation.ar: اللهم ارزقنا حلالا طيبا واكفنا بحلالك عن حرامك

virtues.en: True contentment comes not from having more but from needing less, trusting that Allah provides.
virtues.ar: True contentment comes not from having more but from needing less, trusting that Allah provides.

items.arabic: وَعَسَى أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ
items.transliteration: Wa asa an takrahu shay'an wa huwa khayrun lakum.

translation.en: But perhaps you hate a thing and it is good for you.
translation.ar: وعسى أن تكرهوا شيئا وهو خير لكم

virtues.en: This verse teaches that our limited perspective cannot see the wisdom in Allah decrees. What seems like hardship may be the greatest blessing.
virtues.ar: This verse teaches that our limited perspective cannot see the wisdom in Allah decrees. What seems like hardship may be the greatest blessing.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ النِّفَاقِ وَبَطْنِي مِنَ الشَّكِّ
items.transliteration: Allahumma tahir qalbi minan-nifaqi wa batni minash-shakki.

translation.en: O Allah, purify my heart from hypocrisy and my inner self from doubt.
translation.ar: اللهم طهر قلبي من النفاق وبطني من الشك

virtues.en: The Prophet (SAW) used to make this dua frequently. A sound heart is the only thing that will save a person on the Day of Judgment.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (SAW) used to make this dua frequently. A sound heart is the only thing that will save a person on the Day of Judgment.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يُقَلِّبُ الْقُلُوبَ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma muqallibal-qulubi thabbit qalbi ala deenik.

translation.en: O Allah, Turner of hearts, keep my heart steadfast upon Your religion.
translation.ar: اللهم يقلب القلوب ثبت قلبي على دينك

virtues.en: The Prophet (SAW) said: Hearts turn more than any container turns. This dua of Umm Salamah shows the urgency of asking for steadfastness.
virtues.ar: The Prophet (SAW) said: Hearts turn more than any container turns. This dua of Umm Salamah shows the urgency of asking for steadfastness.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمٍّ لَا يَنْفَجِرُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min hammin la yanfajiru wa min qalbin la yakhsha'u.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry that does not end and from a heart that does not humble.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من هم لا ينفجر ومن قلب لا يخشع

virtues.en: Prayer without khushu is like a body without a soul. This dua asks Allah to remove the inner barriers to meaningful prayer.
virtues.ar: Prayer without khushu is like a body without a soul. This dua asks Allah to remove the inner barriers to meaningful prayer.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni `ibadatik.

translation.en: O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You in an excellent manner.
translation.ar: اللهم أعني على ذكرك وشكرك وحسن عبادتك

virtues.en: Remembering death frequently is one of the greatest acts of worship. It purifies intentions and motivates righteous action.
virtues.ar: Remembering death frequently is one of the greatest acts of worship. It purifies intentions and motivates righteous action.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار

virtues.en: This is the most comprehensive dua in the Quran, covering both worlds. Scholars call it the dua of the people of understanding.
virtues.ar: This is the most comprehensive dua in the Quran, covering both worlds. Scholars call it the dua of the people of understanding.

items.arabic: وَلَا تَيْأَسُوا مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِنْ رَوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
items.transliteration: Wa la tay'asoo min rawhillah, innahu la yay'asu min rawhillah illal-qawmul-kafiroon.

translation.en: And do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of Allah mercy except the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ولا تيأسوا من روح الله إنه لا ييأس من روح الله إلا القوم الكافرون

virtues.en: Despair is a spiritual disease. This verse, spoken by Prophet Yaqub, is a cure for the heart that has lost hope in Allah mercy.
virtues.ar: Despair is a spiritual disease. This verse, spoken by Prophet Yaqub, is a cure for the heart that has lost hope in Allah mercy.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ
items.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin.

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes.
translation.ar: ربنا هب لنا من أزواجنا وذرياتنا قرة أعين

virtues.en: This dua connects marital harmony to taqwa. Scholars note that qurrat al-ayn means the joy that brings tears of gratitude.
virtues.ar: This dua connects marital harmony to taqwa. Scholars note that qurrat al-ayn means the joy that brings tears of gratitude.

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li minas-saliheen.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from among the righteous.
translation.ar: رب هب لي من الصالحين

virtues.en: This was Ibrahim dua after decades of waiting. It teaches that righteous children are the greatest worldly blessing.
virtues.ar: This was Ibrahim dua after decades of waiting. It teaches that righteous children are the greatest worldly blessing.

items.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi rhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheeran.

translation.en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
translation.ar: رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيرا

virtues.en: This dua connects the mercy shown to us in childhood with the mercy we hope to receive in the Hereafter.
virtues.ar: This dua connects the mercy shown to us in childhood with the mercy we hope to receive in the Hereafter.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْمَعْ أُمَّتِي عَلَى الْحَقِّ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-ijma' ummati `alal-haqq.

translation.en: O Allah, unite my ummah upon the truth.
translation.ar: اللهم اجمع أمتي على الحق

virtues.en: Division of the ummah is one of its greatest trials. This dua asks Allah to bridge differences and unite hearts upon the truth.
virtues.ar: Division of the ummah is one of its greatest trials. This dua asks Allah to bridge differences and unite hearts upon the truth.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة

virtues.en: The Quranic balance: neither monasticism nor materialism. This dua asks for good in BOTH worlds.
virtues.ar: The Quranic balance: neither monasticism nor materialism. This dua asks for good in BOTH worlds.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuka wal-'amalalladhi yuballighuni hubbaka.

translation.en: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and deeds that bring me closer to Your love.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك حبك وحب من يحبك والعمل الذي يبلغني حبك

virtues.en: This is the dua of spiritual progression: loving Allah, loving those close to Allah, and doing what earns His love.
virtues.ar: This is the dua of spiritual progression: loving Allah, loving those close to Allah, and doing what earns His love.

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li hukman wa alhiqani bis-saliheen.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me wisdom and join me with the righteous.
translation.ar: رب هب لي حكما وألحقني بالصالحين

virtues.en: Hikmah (wisdom) is more than knowledge. It is the ability to apply knowledge correctly.
virtues.ar: Hikmah (wisdom) is more than knowledge. It is the ability to apply knowledge correctly.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُ وَلَا تَضُرَّهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahu wa la tadurruh.

translation.en: O Allah, bless it for him and do not cause it any harm.
translation.ar: اللهم بارك له ولا تضره

virtues.en: When you see good in someone else and feel jealousy, the prophetic cure is to pray for blessing upon them.
virtues.ar: When you see good in someone else and feel jealousy, the prophetic cure is to pray for blessing upon them.

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbanaftah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqq wa anta khayrul-fatiheen.

translation.en: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, for You are the best of deciders.
translation.ar: ربنا افتح بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق وأنت خير الفاتحين

virtues.en: Justice is a core value of Islam. This dua teaches us to seek Allah judgment rather than our own.
virtues.ar: Justice is a core value of Islam. This dua teaches us to seek Allah judgment rather than our own.

description.en: Supplications for guidance when choosing between matters — the prophetic istikharah and duas for a good outcome.
description.ar: أدعية الهداية عند الاختيار بين الأمور: الاستخارة النبوية ودعاء حسن العاقبة.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi-'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratika, wa as'aluka min fadlika al-'azim. Fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdiru, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lamu, wa anta 'allamu al-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha al-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fa-qdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fihi. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha al-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fa-srifhu 'anni wa-srifni 'anhu, wa-qdur liya al-khayra haythu kana, thumma ardini bihi.

translation.en: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge and Your power, and I ask You of Your immense bounty. You are able and I am not; You know and I do not; You are the Knower of hidden things. O Allah, if in Your knowledge this matter is good for my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. And if in Your knowledge it is bad for my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me the good wherever it is, and make me content with it.
translation.ar: اللهم إني أستخيرك بعلمك وأستقدرك بقدرتك وأسألك من فضلك العظيم، فإنك تقدر ولا أقدر وتعلم ولا أعلم وأنت علام الغيوب.

reference.notes: Name the specific matter in place of "هذا الأمر" (this matter).

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught the Companions istikharah for all matters as he taught them a surah of the Qur'an. Pray two rak'ahs (other than the obligatory prayer), then recite this dua naming your matter.

title.en: After Choosing — Good in This World and the Next

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fi ad-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhab an-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار.

virtues.en: The most frequent supplication of the Prophet ﷺ (Anas). The verse itself is Qur'an 2:201; asking for the good outcome of any decision is contained within it.

description.en: Remembrance and supplications for the marketplace, honest earning, and freedom from debt.
description.ar: أذكار وأدعية السوق والكسب الحلال والتحرر من الدين.

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa hayyun la yamut, bi-yadihi al-khayr, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

translation.en: There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise; He gives life and death, and He is Ever-Living and does not die; in His hand is all good, and He is able to do all things.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، يحيي ويميت، وهو حي لا يموت، بيده الخير، وهو على كل شيء قدير.

reference.grading: Da'if (per al-Albani; some scholars graded it hasan)
reference.notes: Graded Da'if — knowingly included with its honest grade because of how widely it circulates.

virtues.en: The famous marketplace remembrance: "Whoever enters the marketplace and says it, Allah records a million good deeds for him...". Graded weak by al-Albani in Da'if at-Tirmidhi, so treat it as optional, not an established sunnah — included here for completeness with its honest grading.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma-kfini bi-halalika 'an haramika, wa aghnini bi-fadlika 'amman siwak.

translation.en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, keep me away from what You have forbidden, and enrich me by Your bounty so I need none besides You.
translation.ar: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حرامك، وأغنني بفضلك عمن سواك.

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to a man in debt — the muezzin would call it after prayer so the people could learn it: sufficiency through halal earnings is the heart of honest work.

description.en: The prophetic etiquette of daily life: the greeting of salam, sneezing, yawning, thanks, and home greetings.
description.ar: آداب الحياة اليومية النبوية: السلام والعطاس والتثاؤب والشكر وتحية البيت.

items.arabic: وَإِذَا حُيِّيتُم بِتَحِيَّةٍ فَحَيُّوا بِأَحْسَنَ مِنْهَا أَوْ رُدُّوهَا
items.transliteration: Wa idha huyyitum bi-tahyyatin fa-hayyu bi-ahsana minha aw rudduha.

translation.en: When you are greeted with a greeting, greet in return with what is better than it, or (at least) return it equally. (Reply: "Wa 'alaykum as-salam wa rahmatullah")
translation.ar: وإذا حييتم بتحية فحيوا بأحسن منها أو ردوها.

virtues.en: Returning the salam is an obligation; returning it better ("wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh") is the sunnah of excellence.

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ — يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ — يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah — (reply:) Yarhamuka Allah — (counter-reply:) Yahdikumu Allah wa yuslihu balakum.

translation.en: The one who sneezes says "Alhamdulillah"; his brother replies "May Allah have mercy on you"; he then returns "May Allah guide you and set your affairs right."
translation.ar: الحمد لله — يرحمك الله — يهديكم الله ويصلح بالكم.

virtues.en: The three-part exchange is precisely transmitted in al-Bukhari; saying the counter-reply completes the sunnah.

items.arabic: إِذَا تَثَاءَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَضَعْ يَدَهُ عَلَى فِيهِ
items.transliteration: Idha tathaa'aba ahadukum fa-l-yada' yadahu 'ala fihih.

translation.en: When one of you yawns, let him place his hand over his mouth.
translation.ar: إذا تثاءب أحدكم فليضع يده على فيه.

virtues.en: Yawning in prayer or conversation comes from shaytan when exaggerated — suppressing it and covering the mouth is the prophetic etiquette.

title.en: When Hearing a Rooster or Donkey at Night

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.

translation.en: When you hear a rooster, ask Allah of His bounty (this dua); when you hear a donkey bray, seek refuge with Allah from shaytan ("A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan ir-rajim").
translation.ar: اللهم إني أسألك من فضلك.

reference.book: Book of the Merits of the Ansar

virtues.en: The Prophet ﷺ explained: the rooster saw mercy, so ask for it; the braying donkey saw shaytan, so seek refuge.

title.en: Thanking Someone Who Did Good — Jazakallahu Khayran

items.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا
items.transliteration: Jazaka Allah khayran.

translation.en: May Allah reward you with goodness.
translation.ar: جزاك الله خيرًا.

virtues.en: "Whoever has good done to him and says this to the doer has praised him amply" — the fullest form of thanks to people.

items.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ
items.transliteration: As-salamu 'alaykum.

translation.en: Peace be upon you — say it when entering, even if the house is empty; the greeting is a blessing on its people and the angels who guard it.
translation.ar: السلام عليكم.

virtues.en: "When you enter your home, greet your family with salam — it is a blessing for you and them" — and when none is present, the greeting returns from its guardian angels.
